length_matched_passage: Sleep interruption is the process of purposefully awakening during your normal sleep period and falling asleep a short time later (10–60 minutes). This can be easily done by using a relatively quiet alarm clock to bring you to consciousness without fully waking you. If you find yourself resetting the clock in your sleep, it can be placed on the other side of the room, forcing you to get out of bed to turn it off. Other biorhythm-based options involve drinking lots of fluid (particularly water or tea, a known diuretic) prior to sleep, forcing one to get up to urinate.

flores_passage_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others. That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire. Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions. For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car. He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.
question_en: Based on the passage, under what condition would a person breaking a car window be judged differently than if they were stealing a stranger's car?
mc_answer1_en: If the person had lost their own car keys and was trying to break into their own car
mc_answer2_en: If the person was trying to open a locked door to a public building
mc_answer3_en: If the person was trying to steal a stranger's car
mc_answer4_en: If the person was breaking the window to rescue someone trapped inside

flores_passage_en: "The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean. It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean. With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as ""Hawaii down under"". Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development. The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki."
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following best explains why some elderly visitors might find the Cook Islands reminiscent of Hawaii before statehood?
mc_answer1_en: Because it lacks large tourist hotels and development while still being in Polynesia.
mc_answer2_en: Because it has 15 cities with different cultural influences.
mc_answer3_en: Because it is located in the same time zone as Hawaii.
mc_answer4_en: Because it has large tourist hotels and development like Hawaii.

flores_passage_en: Courier companies are well paid for delivering things quickly. Frequently, time is very important with business documents, merchandise or spare parts for an urgent repair. On some routes, the larger companies have their own planes, but for other routes and smaller firms there was a problem. If they sent things by air freight, on some routes it may have taken days to get through unloading and customs. The only way to get it through faster was to send it as checked luggage. Airline regulations will not allow them to send luggage without a passenger, which is where you come in.
question_en: Based on the passage, why might courier companies send business documents as checked luggage instead of using air freight?
mc_answer1_en: Because airline regulations require all cargo to be checked luggage
mc_answer2_en: Because larger courier companies own their own planes for all routes

flores_passage_en: If the country you will be visiting becomes subject to a travel advisory, your travel health insurance or your trip cancellation insurance may be affected. You may also wish to consult the advice of governments other than your own, but their advice is designed for their citizens. As one example, American citizens in the Middle East might face different situations from Europeans or Arabs. Advisories are merely a brief summary of the political situation in one country. The views presented are often cursory, general and oversimplified compared to the more detailed information available elsewhere.
question_en: If an American citizen is traveling to a country that has issued a travel advisory, what can be reasonably inferred about the applicability of advice from foreign governments compared to their own government's advisory?
mc_answer1_en: It is designed solely for their own citizens and may not address the specific risks American travelers face.
mc_answer2_en: It may differ based on the specific situations faced by American citizens versus those of other nationalities.
mc_answer3_en: It is more detailed than the domestic advisory because foreign governments have better access to local information.
mc_answer4_en: It will be identical because all governments provide the same level of detail regardless of citizenship.

question: ඇමරිකානු පුරවැසියෙක් සංචාරක උපදේශනයක් නිකුත් කර ඇති රටකට ගමන් කරන්නේ නම්, තමන්ගේම රජයේ උපදේශනයට සාපේක්ෂව විදේශීය රජයන්ගෙන් ලැබෙන උපදෙස් වල අදාළත්වය ගැන සාධාරණ ලෙස නිගමනය කළ හැක්කේ කුමක්ද?
mc_answer1: එය තනිකරම සැලසුම් කර ඇත්තේ ඔවුන්ගේම පුරවැසියන් සඳහා වන අතර ඇමරිකානු සංචාරකයින් මුහුණ දෙන විශේෂිත අවදානම් විසඳීමට නොහැකි විය හැකිය.
mc_answer2: ඇමරිකානු පුරවැසියන් මුහුණ දෙන විශේෂිත තත්වයන් මත පදනම්ව එය වෙනස් විය හැකිය.
mc_answer3: එය දේශීය උපදේශනයට වඩා සවිස්තරාත්මකයි මොකද විදේශීය රජයන්ට දේශීය තොරතුරු වලට වඩා හොඳ ප් රවේශයක් තියෙනවා.
mc_answer4: එය සමාන වනු ඇත මන්දයත් සියලුම රජයන් පුරවැසිභාවය නොසලකා එකම මට්ටමේ විස්තර සපයයි.

flores_passage_en: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen states first formed a weak central government—with the Congress being its only component—under the Articles of Confederation. Congress lacked any power to impose taxes, and, because there was no national executive or judiciary, it relied on state authorities, who were often uncooperative, to enforce all its acts. It also had no authority to override tax laws and tariffs between states. The Articles required unanimous consent from all the states before they could be amended and states took the central government so lightly that their representatives were often absent.

mc_answer1_en: It was ineffective because states often did not cooperate with the central government's enforcement of acts.
mc_answer2_en: It was ineffective because the Articles could be amended with a simple majority vote.

Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words. Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses. Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes. Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

mc_answer2_en: Patience and a telephoto lens for shy animals

flores_passage_en: "Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families. The ""typical"" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home. There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of ""going to Disney World"". Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets. While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable."
question_en: According to the passage, what is the relationship between the typical Disney World visit and the resale of tickets on auction websites?
mc_answer1_en: The typical visit and ticket resale are unrelated concepts in the passage.
mc_answer2_en: The typical visit requires a full week on-site, making ticket resale more common.
mc_answer3_en: Ticket resale is encouraged to accommodate variations in the typical visit.
mc_answer4_en: The typical visit involves flying into Orlando, but ticket resale is a separate prohibited activity.

question: මෙම ඡේදයට අනුව, සාමාන් ය ඩිස්නි වර්ල්ඩ් සංචාරය සහ වෙන්දේසි වෙබ් අඩවි වල ප් රවේශ පත් ර නැවත විකිණීම අතර ඇති සම්බන්ධය කුමක්ද?

flores_passage_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time. Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range. In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen. German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines. Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.
question_en: Based on the passage, why were submarines forced to travel underwater during the later stages of World War II?
mc_answer1_en: Because they needed to avoid detection by increasingly accurate radar technology
mc_answer2_en: Because they were designed to travel underwater
mc_answer3_en: Because German submarines were not trusted after the war
mc_answer4_en: Because they were very slow and had a limited shooting range

flores_passage_en: While project based learning should make learning easier and more interesting, scaffolding goes a step beyond. Scaffolding is not a method of learning but rather an aid that provides support to individuals whom are undergoing a new learning experience such as using a new computer program or beginning a new project. Scaffolds can be both virtual and real, in other words, a teacher is a form of scaffold but so is the little paperclip man in Microsoft Office. Virtual Scaffolds are internalized in the software and are meant to question, prompt, and explain procedures that may have been to challenging for the student to handle alone.

flores_passage_en: Virtual teams are held to the same standards of excellence as conventional teams, but there are subtle differences. Virtual team members often function as the point of contact for their immediate physical group. They often have more autonomy than conventional team members as their teams may meet according to varying time zones which may not be understood by their local management. The presence of a true “invisible team” (Larson and LaFasto, 1989, p109) is also a unique component of a virtual team. The “invisible team” is the management team to which each of the members report. The invisible team sets the standards for each member.
question_en: According to the passage, which of the following best describes the relationship between virtual team members and their local management?
mc_answer1_en: Virtual team members function as the point of contact for the invisible team.
mc_answer2_en: Virtual team members may have more autonomy than conventional team members due to varying time zones that local management may not understand.
mc_answer3_en: Local management always understands the varying time zones of virtual teams.
mc_answer4_en: The invisible team sets the standards for conventional teams only.

flores_passage_en: The stretch between Point Marion and Fairmont presents the most challenging driving conditions on the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway, passing frequently through isolated backwoods terrain. If you're not used to driving on country roads, keep your wits about you: steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves predominate. Posted speed limits are noticeably lower than in previous and subsequent sections — commonly 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — and strict obedience to them is even more important than otherwise. Curiously, though, mobile phone service is much stronger here than along many other stretches of the route, e.g. the Pennsylvania Wilds.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following statements accurately reflects the driving conditions and connectivity in the stretch between Point Marion and Fairmont compared to other sections of the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway?
mc_answer1_en: Mobile phone service is weaker here than in previous and subsequent sections, but drivers can still navigate safely by adhering to the posted speed limits of 35-40 mph.
mc_answer2_en: Drivers must exercise extra caution due to steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves, yet they can expect stronger mobile phone service than in areas like the Pennsylvania Wilds.

flores_passage: බෆලෝ-පිට්ස්බර්ග් අධිවේගී මාර්ගයේ වඩාත්ම අභියෝගාත්මක රිය පැදවීමේ තත්වයන් ඉදිරිපත් කරන්නේ පොයින්ට් මාරියන් සහ ෆෙයාර්මොන්ට් අතර කොටසයි. ඔබ හුදකලා පසුබිම් භූමි ප් රදේශයක් හරහා නිතර නිතර ගමන් කරයි. ඔබ ග් රාමීය මාර්ගවල රිය පැදීමට පුරුදු වී නොමැති නම්, ඔබ ගැන ඔබේ බුද්ධිය තබා ගන්න: තියුණු ශ් රේණි, පටු මංතීරු සහ තියුණු වක් ර පවතී. පළ කළ වේග සීමාවන් පෙර සහ පසු කොටස් වලට වඩා සැලකිය යුතු ලෙස අඩුය. සාමාන් යයෙන් පැයට සැතපුම් 35-40 (56-64 km/h)  ඒවාට දැඩි ලෙස කීකරු වීම වෙනදාට වඩා වැදගත් වේ. කෙසේ වෙතත්, සිත්ගන්නා කරුණ නම්, මාර්ගයේ වෙනත් බොහෝ කොටස් වලට වඩා ජංගම දුරකථන සේවාව මෙහි වඩා ශක්තිමත් ය.
question: මෙම ඡේදය මත පදනම්ව, බෆලෝ-පිට්ස්බර්ග් අධිවේගී මාර්ගයේ අනෙකුත් කොටස් වලට සාපේක්ෂව පොයින්ට් මාරියන් සහ ෆෙයාර්මොන්ට් අතර කොටසෙහි රිය පැදවීමේ තත්වයන් සහ සම්බන්ධතාවය නිවැරදිව පිළිබිඹු කරන්නේ කුමන ප් රකාශයද?
mc_answer1: ජංගම දුරකථන සේවාව මෙහි පෙර හා පසු කොටස් වලට වඩා දුර්වලයි, නමුත් රියදුරන්ට තවමත් සැතපුම් 35-40 ක වේග සීමාවන්ට අනුකූලව ආරක්ෂිතව ගමන් කළ හැකිය.
mc_answer2: රථවාහන රියදුරන් ඉතා ප් රවේශම් විය යුතුය. මන්දයත් කඳු බෑවුම්, පටු මංතීරු සහ තියුණු වක් ර නිසාය. කෙසේ වෙතත්, ඔවුන් පෙන්සිල්වේනියා වල් වැනි ප් රදේශවලට වඩා ශක්තිමත් ජංගම දුරකථන සේවාවක් අපේක්ෂා කළ හැකිය.
mc_answer3: කඳු බෑවුම් සහ පටු මංතීරු තිබියදීත්, පළ කර ඇති වේග සීමාවන් පෙර කොටස් වලට වඩා ඉහළ මට්ටමක පවතින අතර හුදෙකලා වූ පසුබිම් භූමියක ජංගම දුරකථන සේවාවක් නොමැත.
mc_answer4: මාර්ග තත්වයන් මාර්ගයේ අනෙකුත් කොටස් වලට සමාන වේග සීමාවන් සහ ජංගම දුරකථන ආවරණයක් ඇති අතර, එය පළපුරුදු රියදුරන්ට අභියෝගයක් නොවේ.

flores_passage_en: Organisers of the protest said about 100,000 people turned up in German cities such as Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, and Hanover. In Berlin, police estimated 6,500 protestors. flores_passage: ජර්මනියේ බර්ලින්, කොලෝන්, හැම්බර්ග් සහ හැනෝවර් වැනි නගරවල 100,000 ක් පමණ ජනතාව පැමිණ ඇති බව විරෝධතාව සංවිධායකයින් පැවසීය. බර්ලින්හි පොලිසිය විරෝධතාකරුවන් 6,500 ක් ගණන් බලා ඇත. පැරිසියේ, බල්ගේරියාවේ සොෆියා, ලිතුවේනියාවේ විල්නියස්, මෝල්ටාවේ වැලෙට්ටා, එස්තෝනියාවේ ටැලින් සහ එඩින්බරෝ සහ ස්කොට්ලන්තයේ ග්ලාස්ගෝ යන නගරවල ද විරෝධතා පැවැත්විණි. ලන්ඩනයේ 200 ක් පමණ ජනතාව ප් රධාන ප් රකාශන හිමිකරුවන්ගේ කාර්යාල ඉදිරිපිට විරෝධතා දැක්වූහ. පසුගිය මාසයේදී පෝලන්තයේ ACTA අත්සන් කළ විට විශාල විරෝධතා පැවති අතර එමඟින් පෝලන්ත රජය දැනට ගිවිසුම අනුමත නොකිරීමට තීරණය කළේය. ලැට්වියාව සහ ස්ලොවැකියාව යන දෙකම ACTA හා සම්බන්ධ වීමේ ක් රියාවලිය ප් රමාද කළේය.
question: මෙම ඡේදය මත පදනම්ව, පෝලන්තයේ විරෝධතා සහ ACTA සම්බන්ධයෙන් රජයේ තීරණය අතර සම්බන්ධතාවය වඩාත් හොඳින් පැහැදිලි කරන්නේ කුමන ප් රකාශයද?
mc_answer1: පෝලන්තයේ උද්ඝෝෂණ වලට ACTA අත්සන් කිරීම සම්බන්ධයක් තිබුනේ නැහැ.
mc_answer2: විරෝධතා තිබියදීත් ACTA සම්මත කිරීමට රජය තීරණය කළා.
mc_answer3: ACTA එක පෝලන්තයේ අත්සන් කලා ඒත් එතන කිසිම විරෝධතාවක් සිද්ධ වුනේ නෑ.
mc_answer4: මෙම විරෝධතා නිසා රජය ACTA තහවුරු කිරීම තාවකාලිකව ප් රමාද කිරීමට හේතු විය.

question_en: According to the passage, why did Italy need to remove British bases and ships in Egypt?
mc_answer1_en: To prevent Germany from using Egyptian ports for its navy
mc_answer2_en: To establish a naval alliance with Japan against Britain

flores_passage_en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps. At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient. The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures. Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole. Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.
question_en: According to the passage, which of the following best explains why summer shoes are particularly dangerous on icy surfaces compared to other footwear mentioned?
mc_answer1_en: Summer shoes lack the deep tread patterns and soft material required for cold temperatures, making them more slippery than winter boots or studded alternatives.
mc_answer2_en: Summer shoes are made of materials that harden in cold temperatures, but they still absorb sand and gravel effectively.
mc_answer3_en: Summer shoes have heels that are too low and wide, which prevents proper traction on salt-scattered roads.
mc_answer4_en: Summer shoes are too heavy for icy conditions, causing instability that leads to falls on pavements and steps.

flores_passage_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences. Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history. International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants. Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not. These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.
question_en: According to the passage, which statement accurately combines information about the duration and location requirements for World Expos and International Horticultural Expositions?
mc_answer1_en: They primarily focus on national pavilions displaying arts and sciences.
mc_answer2_en: They typically last between three and six months and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.
mc_answer3_en: They are limited to sites smaller than 50 hectares to ensure exclusivity.
mc_answer4_en: They can occur annually without restrictions on country location.
flores_passage: ලෝක ප් රදර්ශනය (සාමාන් යයෙන් ලෝක ප් රදර්ශනය හෝ එක්ස්පෝ ලෙස හැඳින්වේ) යනු කලා හා විද් යාවන්හි විශාල ජාත් යන්තර උත්සවයකි. සහභාගී වන රටවල් ලෝක ගැටලු හෝ ඔවුන්ගේ රටේ සංස්කෘතිය හා ඉතිහාසය ප් රදර්ශනය කිරීම සඳහා ජාතික මණ්ඩපවල කලාත්මක හා අධ් යාපනික සංදර්ශන ඉදිරිපත් කරයි. ජාත් යන්තර උද් යාන විද් යා ප් රදර්ශන යනු මල් ප් රදර්ශන, උද්භිද උද් යාන සහ ශාක හා සම්බන්ධ වෙනත් ඕනෑම දෙයක් ප් රදර්ශනය කරන විශේෂිත සිදුවීම් වේ. න් යායාත්මකව ඒවා වාර්ෂිකව පැවැත්විය හැකි වුවද (විවිධ රටවල පවතින තාක් කල්), ප් රායෝගිකව ඒවා එසේ නොවේ. මෙම සිදුවීම් සාමාන් යයෙන් මාස තුනක් සහ හයක් අතර ඕනෑම තැනක පැවැත්වේ.
question: මෙම ඡේදයට අනුව, ලෝක ප් රදර්ශන සහ ජාත් යන්තර උද් යාන විද් යා ප් රදර්ශන සඳහා අවශ් ය කාලසීමාව සහ ස්ථානය පිළිබඳ තොරතුරු නිවැරදිව ඒකාබද්ධ කරන්නේ කුමන ප් රකාශයද?
mc_answer1: ඔවුන් ප් රධාන වශයෙන් අවධානය යොමු කරන්නේ කලා සහ විද් යාවන් ප් රදර්ශනය කරන ජාතික කුටි වෙතයි.
mc_answer2: ඒවා සාමාන් යයෙන් මාස තුනක් සහ හයක් අතර කාලයක් පවතින අතර ඒවා හෙක්ටයාර 50 කට වඩා කුඩා නොවන ස්ථානවල පවත්වනු ලැබේ.
mc_answer3: ඒවා හෙක්ටයාර 50කට වඩා කුඩා භූමි ප් රමාණයකට සීමා කරලා තියෙන්නේ ඒකීයභාවය තහවුරු කරගන්න.
mc_answer4: ඒවා වාර්ෂිකව සිදුවිය හැකිය රටක පිහිටීම මත සීමාවන් නොමැතිව.

flores_passage_en: The first cases of the disease this season were reported in late July. The disease is carried by pigs, which then migrates to humans through mosquitos. The outbreak has prompted the Indian government to undertake such measures as deployment of pig catchers in seriously affected areas, distributing thousands of mosquito curtains and spraying pesticides. Several million vials of encephalitis vaccine have also been promised by the government, which will help prepare health agencies for next year. Plans for vaccines to be delivered to the historically most affected areas this year were delayed due to lack of funds and low prioritisation relative to other diseases.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following best explains why the vaccine delivery plans for historically most affected areas were delayed this year?
mc_answer1_en: The outbreak was not severe enough to warrant immediate vaccine distribution in affected regions.
mc_answer2_en: Mosquito curtains and pig catchers were more effective than vaccines in controlling the disease.
mc_answer3_en: The vaccine vials were reserved exclusively for health agencies preparing for the following year.
mc_answer4_en: The government lacked sufficient funds and prioritized other diseases over this outbreak.
flores_passage: මෙම වසංගතයේ පළමු රෝගීන් ජූලි මස අගදී වාර්තා විය. මෙම රෝගය ඌරන් විසින් ගෙන යනු ලබන අතර පසුව මදුරුවන් හරහා මිනිසුන්ට සංක් රමණය වේ. මෙම වසංගතය හේතුවෙන් ඉන්දියානු රජය බරපතල ලෙස බලපෑමට ලක් වූ ප් රදේශවල ඌරන් අල්ලා ගන්නන් යෙදවීම, මදුරුවන් තිර රෙදි දහස් ගණනක් බෙදා හැරීම සහ පළිබෝධනාශක ඉසීම වැනි පියවර ගැනීමට පෙළඹී තිබේ. එන්සෆලයිටිස් එන්නත මිලියන ගණනක් ලබා දීමට රජය පොරොන්දු වී ඇති අතර එය ලබන වසර සඳහා සෞඛ් ය ආයතන සූදානම් කිරීමට උපකාරී වේ. ඉතිහාසයේ වඩාත්ම බලපෑමට ලක් වූ ප් රදේශවලට එන්නත් ලබා දීමේ සැලසුම් මේ වසරේ ප් රමාද වූයේ අරමුදල් නොමැතිකම සහ වෙනත් රෝගවලට සාපේක්ෂව අඩු ප් රමුඛතාවයක් ලබා දීම හේතුවෙනි.
question: මෙම ඡේදය මත පදනම්ව, ඉතිහාසයේ වැඩිපුරම බලපෑමට ලක් වූ ප් රදේශ සඳහා එන්නත් ලබා දීමේ සැලසුම් මේ වසරේ ප් රමාද වීමට හේතුව පහත සඳහන් කුමන හොඳම පැහැදිලි කිරීමද?
mc_answer1: වසංගතය ආසාදිත ප් රදේශවල වහාම එන්නත් බෙදා හැරීමට අවශ් ය තරම් බරපතල නොවීය.
mc_answer2: මදුරු ආවරණ සහ ඌරන් අල්ලා ගැනීමේ ආයුධ එන්නත් වලට වඩා ඵලදායී විය.

mc_answer4: රජයට ප් රමාණවත් අරමුදල් නොමැති වූ අතර මෙම වසංගතයට වඩා වෙනත් රෝග වලට ප් රමුඛතාවය දුන්නේය.

flores_passage_en: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn. In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented. Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point. So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge. We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.
question_en: Which of the following statements does not accurately reflect a post modern learning approach?
mc_answer1_en: There are numerous ways to learn information
mc_answer2_en: Certain learning experiences should be prioritized over others
mc_answer3_en: A learning experience relies on the learner and the presented knowledge
mc_answer4_en: Knowledge that we may never apply is still worth learning

flores_passage_en: Muhammad was deeply interested in matters beyond this mundane life. He used to frequent a cave that became known as “Hira‘” on the Mountain of “Noor” (light) for contemplation. he cave itself, which survived the times, gives a very vivid image of Muhammad’s spiritual inclinations. Resting on the top of one of the mountains north of Mecca, the cave is completely isolated from the rest of the world. In fact, it is not easy to find at all even if one knew it existed. Once inside the cave, it is a total isolation. Nothing can be seen other than the clear, beautiful sky above and the many surrounding mountains. Very little of this world can be seen or heard from inside the cave.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following best explains why Muhammad's spiritual inclinations are vividly illustrated by the cave's isolation?
mc_answer1_en: Because the clear, beautiful sky visible from inside the cave was considered a direct portal to the afterlife by early Islamic scholars.
mc_answer2_en: Because the cave's complete isolation from the world, where very little of it can be seen or heard, mirrors his interest in matters beyond the mundane life.
mc_answer3_en: Because the cave's physical location on the Mountain of Noor allowed him to easily access worldly supplies during contemplation.
mc_answer4_en: Because the cave's survival over time indicates that it was built specifically to accommodate large groups of followers seeking spiritual guidance.

question: මෙම ඡේදය මත පදනම්ව, ගුහාවේ හුදෙකලාව මුහම්මද්ගේ අධ් යාත්මික නැඹුරුව වඩාත් පැහැදිලිව නිරූපණය කරන්නේ මන්දැයි පහත සඳහන් කුමන කොටසින් වඩාත් හොඳින් පැහැදිලි කරයිද?

Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration. Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible. The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo. Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.
question_en: Based on the passage, which statement best explains why visitors with limited time might choose to visit the Tomb of Tutankhamun despite its limitations?
mc_answer1_en: The tomb is the only location where one can see evidence of damage to the mummy done during removal from the coffin.
mc_answer2_en: The tomb contains the original fabulous riches, offering a unique experience unmatched elsewhere.
mc_answer3_en: The tomb's small size and limited decoration make it a quick but rewarding visit.
mc_answer4_en: Visitors with limited time are advised to spend their time elsewhere, implying the tomb is not recommended for such visitors.

KV62 නිම්නයේ වඩාත්ම ප් රසිද්ධ සොහොන විය හැකිය, 1922 දී හොවාර්ඩ් කාටර් විසින් තරුණ රජුගේ පාහේ නොවෙනස් වූ රාජකීය භූමදානය සොයා ගන්නා ලදී. කෙසේ වෙතත්, අනෙකුත් රාජකීය සොහොන් බොහොමයක් සමඟ සසඳන විට, ටුටන්කාමන්ගේ සොහොන ඉතා කුඩා හා සීමිත සැරසිලි සහිතව සංචාරය කිරීම වටී. මිනී පෙට්ටියෙන් ඉවත් කිරීමට උත්සාහ කිරීමේදී මියගිය අයෙකුට සිදුවූ හානිය පිළිබඳ සාක්ෂි දැකීමට උනන්දුවක් දක්වන ඕනෑම අයෙකු කලකිරීමට පත් වනු ඇත. සොහොනෙහි අපූරු ධනයන් තවදුරටත් එහි නොමැත, නමුත් ඒවා කයිරෝහි ඊජිප්තු කෞතුකාගාරයට ගෙන ගොස් ඇත. සීමිත කාලයක් ඇති අමුත්තන් වෙනත් තැනක කාලය ගත කිරීම වඩාත් සුදුසුය.
question: මෙම ඡේදය මත පදනම්ව, සීමිත කාලයක් ඇති අමුත්තන් එහි සීමාවන් තිබියදීත් ටුටන්කාමන්ගේ සොහොන නැරඹීමට තෝරා ගත හැක්කේ මන්දැයි පැහැදිලි කරන්නේ කුමන ප් රකාශයද?
mc_answer1: මිනී පෙට්ටියෙන් ඉවත් කිරීමේදී මව්කිරි වලට සිදු වූ හානිය පිළිබඳ සාක්ෂි දැකිය හැකි එකම ස්ථානය සොහොනයි.
mc_answer2: මෙම සොහොන් ගෙය මුල් සුරංගනා පොහොසත්කම් වලින් සමන්විත වන අතර, වෙනත් කිසි තැනක නැති සුවිශේෂී අත්දැකීමක් ලබා දෙයි.

flores_passage_en: Booking in advance gives the traveller peace of mind that they will have somewhere to sleep once they arrive at their destination. Travel agents often have deals with specific hotels, although you may find it possible to book other forms of accommodation, like camping grounds, through a travel agent. Travel agents usually offer packages that include breakfast, transportation arrangements to/from the airport or even combined flight and hotel packages. They can also hold the reservation for you if you need time to think about the offer or procure other documents for your destination (e.g. visa). Any amendments or requests though should be coursed through the travel agent first and not directly with the hotel.
question_en: According to the passage, which type of traveler is not likely to benefit from using a travel agent’s services?
mc_answer1_en: An indecisive traveler
mc_answer2_en: A traveler prone to spontaneity
mc_answer3_en: A traveler who has not yet secured their visa
mc_answer4_en: A traveler who prefers booking package deals

flores_passage_en: The Sundarbans are the largest littoral mangrove belt in the world, stretching 80 km (50 mi) into the Bangladeshi and Indian hinterland from the coast. The Sundarbans has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The part of the forest within Indian territory is called Sundarbans National Park. The forests aren't just mangrove swamps though — they include some of the last remaining stands of the mighty jungles which once covered the Gangetic plain. The Sundarbans cover an area of 3,850 km², of which about one-third is covered in water/marsh areas. Since 1966 the Sundarbans have been a wildlife sanctuary, and it is estimated that there are now 400 Royal Bengal tigers and about 30,000 spotted deer in the area.
question_en: Based on the passage, which statement accurately describes the ecological composition of the Sundarbans National Park?
mc_answer1_en: It was established as a wildlife sanctuary in 1966 to protect the Royal Bengal tigers exclusively.
mc_answer2_en: It consists entirely of mangrove swamps with no other forest types.
mc_answer3_en: It includes both mangrove swamps and remnants of the ancient Gangetic plain jungles.
mc_answer4_en: It is primarily composed of water/marsh areas with minimal forest cover.

question: සෞන්දර්බන් ජාතික වනෝද් යානයේ පරිසර සංයුතිය හරියටම විස්තර කරන්නේ කුමන වාක් ය ඛණ්ඩයද?

mc_answer2: එය මුළුමනින්ම වෙනත් වනාන්තර වර්ග නොමැතිව මැන්ග් රෝව් තණබිම් වලින් සමන්විත වේ.
mc_answer3: මැන්ග් රෝව් තණබිම් සහ පැරණි ගංගා තණබිම් වනාන්තරවල නටබුන් ද මෙහි දක්නට ලැබේ.
mc_answer4: එය ප් රධාන වශයෙන් අවම වනාන්තර ආවරණයක් සහිත ජල / තෙත්බිම් ප් රදේශ වලින් සමන්විත වේ.

flores_passage_en: The Iraq Study Group presented its report at 12.00 GMT today. It warns No one can guarantee that any course of action in Iraq at this point will stop sectarian warfare, growing violence, or a slide toward chaos. The Report opens with plea for open debate and the formation of a consensus in the United States about the policy towards the Middle East. The Report is highly critical of almost every aspect of the present policy of the Executive towards Iraq and it urges an immediate change of direction. First among its 78 recommendations is that a new diplomatic initiative should be taken before the end of this year to secure Iraq’s borders against hostile interventions and to re-establish diplomatic relations with its neighbors.
question_en: According to the Iraq Study Group report, what specific action is urged to be taken before the end of this year to address Iraq's security concerns?
mc_answer1_en: To change the Executive's policy without any specific timeline or recommendations
mc_answer2_en: To guarantee that any course of action will stop sectarian warfare and violence
mc_answer3_en: To issue a plea for open debate and consensus formation within the United States
mc_answer4_en: To launch a new diplomatic initiative aimed at securing Iraq's borders and re-establishing diplomatic relations with its neighbors

question: ඉරාකයේ අධ් යයන කණ්ඩායමේ වාර්තාවට අනුව, ඉරාකයේ ආරක්ෂක ගැටලු විසඳීම සඳහා මේ වසර අවසන් වීමට පෙර ගත යුතු විශේෂිත ක් රියාමාර්ග මොනවාද?

flores_passage_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo. The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE. Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.
question_en: According to the passage, what was the primary cause of the significant reduction in the Taíno population shortly after European explorers arrived?
mc_answer1_en: They were displaced by the Caribes who arrived earlier
mc_answer2_en: They migrated to other parts of the Americas

flores_passage_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas. The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society. However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture. There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand. They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out
question_en: Based on the passage, which statement best explains the historical misunderstanding regarding the origin of the Moriori people?
mc_answer1_en: The Moriori were actually a subgroup of Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, but early theories incorrectly portrayed them as the original inhabitants displaced by the Maori.
mc_answer2_en: The Moriori were originally a separate group that migrated from Polynesia to the Chatham Islands before the Maori arrived in New Zealand.
mc_answer3_en: The Moriori were the first inhabitants of New Zealand who were displaced by the Maori Great Fleet migration from Polynesia.
mc_answer4_en: The Moriori were a Maori tribe that migrated from the Chatham Islands to New Zealand and were later wiped out in conflicts with the mainland Maori.

mc_answer1: මොරියෝරි ඇත්ත වශයෙන්ම නිව්සීලන්තයේ සිට චැතම් දූපත් වෙත සංක් රමණය වූ මාඕරිවරුන්ගේ උප කණ්ඩායමක් වූ නමුත් මුල් න් යායන් මගින් ඔවුන් වැරදි ලෙස නිරූපණය කර ඇත්තේ මාඕරිවරුන් විසින් විස්ථාපනය කරන ලද මුල් වැසියන් ලෙස ය.
mc_answer2: මොරියෝරි ප් රජාව මුලින් නිව්සීලන්තයට පැමිණීමට පෙර පොලිනීසියාවේ සිට චැතම් දූපත් වෙත සංක් රමණය වූ වෙනම කණ්ඩායමක් විය.
mc_answer3: මොරියෝරි නවසීලන්තයේ පළමු වැසියන් වූ අතර මොරියෝරි මහා නාවික හමුදාව පොලිනීසියාවෙන් සංක් රමණය වීමෙන් අවතැන් විය.

flores_passage_en: In France, voting has traditionally been a low-tech experience: voters isolate themselves in a booth, put a pre-printed sheet of paper indicating their candidate of choice into an envelope. After officials verify the voter's identity, the voter drops the envelope into the ballot box and signs the voting roll. French electoral law rather strictly codifies the proceedings. Since 1988, ballot boxes must be transparent so that voters and observers can witness that no envelopes are present at the start of the vote and that no envelopes are added except those of the duly counted and authorized voters. Candidates can send representatives to witness every part of the process. In the evening, votes are counted by volunteers under heavy supervision, following specific procedures.
question_en: According to the passage, what must happen before a voter can sign the voting roll after dropping their envelope into the ballot box?
mc_answer1_en: The voter's identity must be verified by officials.
mc_answer2_en: Candidates must send representatives to witness the process.

question_en: Based on the passage, which statement accurately reflects the relationship between the Prime Minister's actions and the environmental bill review process?

question: එම ඡේදයේ පදනම්ව, අගමැතිවරයාගේ ක් රියාකාරකම් සහ පරිසර පනත සමාලෝචන ක් රියාවලිය අතර සම්බන්ධතාවය නිවැරදිව පිළිබිඹු කරන්නේ කුමන ප් රකාශයද?

flores_passage_en: "Blogs can also help improve student writing. While students often begin their blog experience with sloppy grammar and spelling, the presence of an audience generally changes that. question_en: According to the passage, how does the presence of an audience affect student writing on blogs, and what additional benefit does blogging provide regarding student perspective?
mc_answer1_en: It encourages students to improve their writing to avoid criticism and helps them define their positions in the context of others' writings.

mc_answer3_en: It reduces student engagement with the world around them, leading to more isolated writing habits.
mc_answer4_en: It makes students less analytical by focusing only on their own perspectives without considering others' opinions.
flores_passage: බ්ලොග්කරණය ශිෂ් යයන්ගේ ලිවීම වැඩිදියුණු කිරීමට ද උපකාරී වේ. ශිෂ් යයන් බොහෝ විට ඔවුන්ගේ බ්ලොග් අත්දැකීම් ආරම්භ කරන්නේ නොසැලකිලිමත් ව් යාකරණ සහ අක්ෂර වින් යාසයෙන් වුවද, ප් රේක්ෂකයින්ගේ පැමිණීම සාමාන් යයෙන් එය වෙනස් කරයි. ශිෂ් යයන් බොහෝ විට වඩාත්ම විවේචනාත්මක ප් රේක්ෂකයින් බැවින්, බ්ලොග් ලේඛකයා විවේචන වළක්වා ගැනීම සඳහා ලිවීම වැඩිදියුණු කිරීමට උත්සාහ කිරීමට පටන් ගනී. එසේම බ්ලොග්කරණය ""ඔවුන් වටා ඇති ලෝකය පිළිබඳව වඩාත් දක්ෂ වීමට ශිෂ් යයන් බල කරයි. "" ප් රේක්ෂකයින්ගේ උනන්දුව පෝෂණය කිරීමේ අවශ් යතාව සිසුන්ට බුද්ධිමත් හා සිත්ගන්නාසුළු වීමට පෙළඹවයි (ටෝටෝ, 2004). බ්ලොග්කරණය යනු සාම්ප් රදායික පාසල් දිනයෙන් ඔබ්බට ඉගෙනීම පුළුල් කිරීමට දිරිගන්වන මෙවලමකි. බ්ලොග් නිසි ලෙස භාවිතා කිරීම "" සිසුන්ට වඩාත් විශ්ලේෂණාත්මක හා විවේචාත්මක වීමට බල ගැන්විය හැකිය; අන්තර්ජාල ද් රව් යන්ට ක් රියාකාරීව ප් රතිචාර දැක්වීම තුළින්, සිසුන්ට අන් අයගේ ලේඛන සන්දර්ගයේ සන්දර්භය තුළ ඔවුන්ගේ ස්ථාවන් නිර්ව නිර්වචිත කිරීමට මෙන්ම විශේෂිත ගැටළු පිළිබඳ ඔවුන්ගේම දළඹු දර්ශනයන් දැක්විය හැකිය (Ocrave, 2002). "
question: මෙම ඡේදයට අනුව, ප් රේක්ෂකයන් සිටීම ශිෂ් යයන්ගේ බ්ලොග් ලිවීමට බලපාන්නේ කෙසේද, සහ ශිෂ් ය දෘෂ්ටිකෝණය සම්බන්ධයෙන් බ්ලොග්කරණය මඟින් ලබා දෙන අමතර ප් රතිලාභය කුමක්ද?
mc_answer1: එය විවේචන වළක්වා ගැනීම සඳහා ඔවුන්ගේ ලිවීම වැඩි දියුණු කිරීමට සිසුන් දිරිමත් කරන අතර අන් අයගේ ලේඛනවල සන්දර්භය තුළ ඔවුන්ගේ ස්ථාවරයන් නිර්වචනය කිරීමට ඔවුන්ට උපකාරී වේ.
mc_answer2: එය විවේචනාත්මක චින්තනයේ අවශ් යතාවය ඉවත් කරන අතර ප් රේක්ෂක ප් රතිපෝෂණයකින් තොරව ශිෂ් යයන්ට ව් යවහාරය කෙරෙහි පමණක් අවධානය යොමු කිරීමට ඉඩ සලසයි.
mc_answer3: එය සිසුන්ගේ අවට ලෝකය සමඟ සම්බන්ධතාවය අඩු කරයි, එය වඩාත් හුදකලා ලිවීමේ පුරුදු වලට තුඩු දෙයි.
mc_answer4: එය සිසුන්ට අඩු විශ්ලේෂණශීලී කරයි අන් අයගේ අදහස් නොසලකා ඔවුන්ගේම දෘෂ්ටිකෝණයන් කෙරෙහි පමණක් අවධානය යොමු කිරීමෙන්.

flores_passage_en: "Technological determinism is a term that encompasses a wide range of ideas in practice, from technology-push or the technological imperative to a strict sense that human destiny is driven by an underlying logic associated with scientific laws and their manifestation in technology. Most interpretations of technological determinism share two general ideas: that the development of technology itself follows a path largely beyond cultural or political influence, and that technology in turn has ""effects"" on societies that are inherent, rather than socially conditioned. For example, one might say that the motor car necessarily leads to the development of roads. However, a nationwide road network is not economically viable for just a handful of cars, so new methods of production are developed to reduce the cost of car ownership. Mass car ownership also leads to a higher incidence of accidents on the roads, which leads to the invention of new techniques in healthcare for repairing damaged bodies."
question_en: According to the passage, how does the development of mass car ownership relate to advancements in healthcare?
mc_answer1_en: Mass car ownership directly causes healthcare techniques to be invented.
mc_answer2_en: Higher accident rates from car ownership lead to new healthcare techniques.
mc_answer3_en: Road networks are developed before healthcare techniques are needed.
mc_answer4_en: Technological determinism prevents healthcare from being influenced by car accidents.
flores_passage: "තාක්ෂණික නිර්ණායකවාදය යනු තාක් ෂණික තල්ලුව හෝ තාක් ෂණික අවශ් යතාවයේ සිට මිනිස් ඉරණම විද් යාත්මක නීති හා ඒවායේ ප් රකාශනය හා සම්බන්ධ මූලික තර්කනයකින් මෙහෙයවනු ලැබේ යන දැඩි හැඟීම දක්වා ප් රායෝගිකව අදහස් රාශියක් ඇතුළත් වන යෙදුමකි. තාක් ෂණික නිර්නායකවාදය පිළිබඳ බොහෝ අර්ථ නිරූපණයන් පොදු අදහස් දෙකක් බෙදා ගනී: තාක් ෂණයේ දියුණුව බොහෝ දුරට සංස්කෘතික හෝ දේශපාලන බලපෑමෙන් ඔබ්බට ගිය මාවතක් අනුගමනය කරන අතර තාක් ෂණයට සමාජය මත පදනම් වූවාට වඩා සමාජයට ආවේණික වූ "ප් රතිවිපාක" ඇති බව. නිදසුනක් වශයෙන්, යමෙකුට මෝටර් රථය අනිවාර්යයෙන්ම මාර්ග සංවර්ධනයට තුඩු දෙන බව පැවසිය හැකිය. කෙසේ වෙතත්, මෝටර් රථ අතලොස්සක් සඳහා පමණක් රට පුරා මාර්ග ජාලයක් ආර්ථික වශයෙන් ශක් ය නොවේ, එබැවින් මෝටර් රථන හිමිකත්වීමේ පිරිවැය අඩු කිරීම සඳහා නව නිෂ්පාදන ක් රම නිර්මාණය කෙරේ. මහා වාහන අයිතිය ද මාර්ගවල සිදුවන අනතුරු ඉහළින් සිදුවීමට හේතු වන අතර, හානිසා හානිසා හානිසා හානිසා හානිවනු ලබන නව සෞඛ් ය සේවාරක්ෂණ ක් රම සොයා ගැනීමට හේතු වේ. "
question: මෙම ඡේදයට අනුව, මහජන මෝටර් රථ හිමිකාරිත්වයේ වර්ධනය සෞඛ් ය සේවාවේ දියුණුවට සම්බන්ධ වන්නේ කෙසේද?
mc_answer1: මහජන මෝටර් රථ අයිතිය සෘජුවම සෞඛ්ය සේවා තාක්ෂණයන් නිර්මාණය කිරීමට හේතු වේ.

On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.
question_en: According to the passage, what is the correct procedure regarding passports on night sleeper trains?
mc_answer1_en: Passports are returned immediately after the train departs the station.
mc_answer2_en: Passports should be kept by the passenger at all times to avoid confusion.

Fish often die because of the high concentrations of the toxin in the waters. Humans can be affected by breathing affected water taken into the air by wind and waves.
question_en: If a coastal region experiences a Red tide event where the concentration of Karenia brevis increases by 200% from a baseline of 100 organisms per liter, and the neurotoxin levels are directly proportional to the algae concentration, what is the new concentration of the algae if the baseline concentration doubles before the Red tide event begins?

mc_answer2_en: 500 organisms per liter

mc_answer4_en: 600 organisms per liter

flores_passage_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria. They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List. Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea. flores_passage_en: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole. Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea. flores_passage_en: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings. An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites. A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person. Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases. These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.
question_en: According to the passage, if a traveler intends to visit Country A, which previously had an outbreak of a contagious disease, and then plans to visit Country B, which requires vaccination for diseases transmitted in close proximity to infected persons, what is the most likely reason Country B might require vaccination?
mc_answer1_en: Because the disease is caused by a pathogen like a virus or bacterium.
mc_answer2_en: Because the disease can be transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.
mc_answer3_en: Because the traveler plans to visit a country that requires vaccination for contagious diseases.
mc_answer4_en: Because the traveler has visited a country with an infectious disease outbreak.

flores_passage_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others. That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire. Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions. For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car. He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.
question_en: According to the passage, which of the following scenarios would lead to a different judgment of the person breaking the car window?
mc_answer1_en: The person is breaking the window to escape a fire.
mc_answer2_en: The person is trying to steal a stranger's car.

flores_passage_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states. The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance. The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power. This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

mc_answer2_en: The Hundred Years' War

mc_answer4_en: The Thirty Years' War

flores_passage_en: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances. Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles. Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds. They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow. Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

flores_passage_en: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen states first formed a weak central government—with the Congress being its only component—under the Articles of Confederation. Congress lacked any power to impose taxes, and, because there was no national executive or judiciary, it relied on state authorities, who were often uncooperative, to enforce all its acts. It also had no authority to override tax laws and tariffs between states. The Articles required unanimous consent from all the states before they could be amended and states took the central government so lightly that their representatives were often absent.
question_en: According to the passage, if the Articles of Confederation required unanimous consent for amendment and states frequently sent absent representatives, what logical consequence follows regarding the likelihood of amending the Articles?
mc_answer1_en: Amendments were nearly impossible to achieve due to the requirement for unanimous state approval.
mc_answer2_en: Amendments were facilitated by the presence of a national executive branch.
mc_answer3_en: Amendments were highly likely to occur quickly due to the strong central government.
mc_answer4_en: Amendments could be passed with a simple majority vote from attending representatives.

flores_passage_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots. Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous. These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves. A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk. Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following statements best explains why some scientists argue that Triceratops did not eat cycads?
mc_answer1_en: Cycads were not available during the Cretaceous period.
mc_answer2_en: Triceratops only ate leaves and not branches or roots.
mc_answer3_en: Cycads are considered very poisonous by some scientists.
mc_answer4_en: The Triceratops beak was too weak to strip off the leaves.

flores_passage_en: "Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families. The ""typical"" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home. There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of ""going to Disney World"". Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets. While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable."
question_en: A family plans to buy a partially used multi-day park-hopper ticket from an online auction website. Based on the passage, which of the following statements about the ticket's validity is accurate?

flores_passage_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time. Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range. In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen. German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines. Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following statements about German submarines during World War II is NOT supported by the text?
mc_answer1_en: German submarines were known as U-Boats.
mc_answer2_en: Germans were skilled at navigating and operating their submarines.

flores_passage_en: While project based learning should make learning easier and more interesting, scaffolding goes a step beyond. Scaffolding is not a method of learning but rather an aid that provides support to individuals whom are undergoing a new learning experience such as using a new computer program or beginning a new project. Scaffolds can be both virtual and real, in other words, a teacher is a form of scaffold but so is the little paperclip man in Microsoft Office. Virtual Scaffolds are internalized in the software and are meant to question, prompt, and explain procedures that may have been to challenging for the student to handle alone.
question_en: According to the passage, which of the following best describes the role of scaffolding in a new learning experience?
mc_answer1_en: Scaffolding is an aid that provides support to individuals undergoing a new learning experience.
mc_answer2_en: Scaffolding is a method used exclusively for computer-based training programs.
mc_answer3_en: Scaffolding is a standalone learning method that replaces the need for teachers.
mc_answer4_en: Scaffolding is solely a virtual tool embedded in software like Microsoft Office.

flores_passage_en: Virtual teams are held to the same standards of excellence as conventional teams, but there are subtle differences. Virtual team members often function as the point of contact for their immediate physical group. They often have more autonomy than conventional team members as their teams may meet according to varying time zones which may not be understood by their local management. The presence of a true “invisible team” (Larson and LaFasto, 1989, p109) is also a unique component of a virtual team. The “invisible team” is the management team to which each of the members report. The invisible team sets the standards for each member.
question_en: According to the passage, which of the following best describes the relationship between virtual team members and their 'invisible team'?
mc_answer1_en: Virtual team members are managed by local management, while the invisible team operates independently.
mc_answer2_en: The invisible team is a temporary committee formed to oversee specific virtual projects.
mc_answer3_en: Virtual team members report directly to the invisible team, which sets standards for them.
mc_answer4_en: The invisible team is a subgroup within the virtual team that handles local management issues.

The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center. Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel. Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following statements accurately reflects the relationship between Jerusalem's religious significance and its status as a tourist destination?

question: යෙරුසලමේ ආගමික වැදගත්කම හා එහි සංචාරක ගමනාන්තය අතර ඇති සම්බන්ධය වඩාත් නිවැරදිව පිළිබිඹු කරන්නේ පහත සඳහන් ප් රකාශවලින් කවරක්ද?
mc_answer1: සංචාරක ගමනාන්තයක් ලෙස ජෙරුසලමේ තත්ත්වය එහි ආගමික වැදගත්කමට සම්බන්ධ නැත, ඒ වෙනුවට සාප්පු සවාරි සහ භෝජන සංග් රහ කෙරෙහි අවධානය යොමු කරයි.
mc_answer2: ජෙරුසලම ඊශ් රායලයේ විශාලතම නගරය වන අතර ආගමික ස්ථාන සීමිත වුවද එය ඉහළම සංචාරක ගමනාන්තය බවට පත් කරයි.
mc_answer3: බොහෝ රටවල් ජෙරුසලම ඊශ් රායලයේ අගනුවර ලෙස හඳුනාගෙන ඇති අතර එය සංචාරක ගමනාන්තයක් ලෙස එහි ජනප් රියත්වයට හේතු වේ.
mc_answer4: ජෙරුසලම ප් රධාන සංචාරක ගමනාන්තයක් වන්නේ ප් රධාන වශයෙන් එහි ආගමික ස්ථාන නිසා, විශේෂයෙන් පැරණි නගරයේ ය.

flores_passage_en: "After its adoption by Congress on July 4, a handwritten draft signed by the President of Congress John Hancock and the Secretary Charles Thomson was then sent a few blocks away to the printing shop of John Dunlap. Through the night between 150 and 200 copies were made, now known as ""Dunlap broadsides"". The first public reading of the document was by John Nixon in the yard of Independence Hall on July 8. One was sent to George Washington on July 6, who had it read to his troops in New York on July 9. A copy reached London on August 10. The 25 Dunlap broadsides still known to exist are the oldest surviving copies of the document. The original handwritten copy has not survived."

flores_passage_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana. The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay. In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic. You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls. On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!
question_en: Based on the passage, during which months is the water volume at Victoria Falls highest, and what is the primary effect of this condition on viewing the Falls?

mc_answer2_en: April to October; the Falls are more dramatic but often obscured by water
mc_answer3_en: November to March; the Falls are less dramatic and easier to view

flores_passage_en: The Sundarbans are the largest littoral mangrove belt in the world, stretching 80 km (50 mi) into the Bangladeshi and Indian hinterland from the coast. The Sundarbans has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The part of the forest within Indian territory is called Sundarbans National Park. The forests aren't just mangrove swamps though — they include some of the last remaining stands of the mighty jungles which once covered the Gangetic plain. The Sundarbans cover an area of 3,850 km², of which about one-third is covered in water/marsh areas. Since 1966 the Sundarbans have been a wildlife sanctuary, and it is estimated that there are now 400 Royal Bengal tigers and about 30,000 spotted deer in the area.

flores_passage_en: "Prime Minister Stephen Harper has agreed to send the government's 'Clean Air Act' to an all-party committee for review, before its second reading, after Tuesday's 25 minute meeting with NDP leader Jack Layton at the PMO. Layton had asked for changes to the conservatives' environmental bill during the meeting with the PM, asking for a ""thorough and complete rewriting"" of the Conservative party's environmental bill. Ever since the Federal Government stepped in to take over funding of the Mersey hospital in Devonport, Tasmania, the state government and some federal MPs have criticised this act as a stunt in the prelude to the federal election to be called by November. But Prime Minister John Howard has said the act was only to safeguard the facilities of the hospital from being downgraded by the Tasmanian government, in giving an extra AUD$45 million."
question_en: According to the passage, which of the following statements is TRUE regarding the timeline and events described?

mc_answer2_en: The Mersey hospital in Devonport, Tasmania, received no additional funding.

mc_answer4_en: The federal election is scheduled to be called by November.

flores_passage_en: "Blogs can also help improve student writing. While students often begin their blog experience with sloppy grammar and spelling, the presence of an audience generally changes that. Since students are often the most critical audience, the blog writer begins to strive to improve writing to avoid criticism. Also blogging ""forces students to become more savvy about the world around them."" The need to feed the interest of the audience inspires students to be clever and interesting (Toto, 2004). Blogging is a tool that inspires collaboration, and encourages students to extend learning well beyond the traditional school day. Appropriate use of blogs ""can empower students to become more analytical and critical; through actively responding to Internet materials, students can define their positions in the context of others' writings as well as outline their own perspectives on particular issues (Oravec, 2002)."
question_en: Based on the passage, if a student starts with 50 posts on their blog and decides to increase their posting frequency by 20% each month for two months to meet audience expectations, how many posts will they have after the second month, assuming they do not delete any posts?
mc_answer1_en: 80 posts
mc_answer2_en: 72 posts

flores_passage: බ්ලොග්කරණය ශිෂ් යයන්ගේ ලිවීම වැඩිදියුණු කිරීමට ද උපකාරී වේ. ශිෂ් යයන් බොහෝ විට ඔවුන්ගේ බ්ලොග් අත්දැකීම් ආරම්භ කරන්නේ නොසැලකිලිමත් ව් යාකරණ සහ අක්ෂර වින් යාසයෙන් වුවද, ප් රේක්ෂකයින්ගේ පැමිණීම සාමාන් යයෙන් එය වෙනස් කරයි. ශිෂ් යයන් බොහෝ විට වඩාත්ම විවේචනාත්මක ප් රේක්ෂකයින් බැවින්, බ්ලොග් ලේඛකයා විවේචන වළක්වා ගැනීම සඳහා ලිවීම වැඩිදියුණු කිරීමට උත්සාහ කිරීමට පටන් ගනී. එසේම බ්ලොග්කරණය ""ඔවුන් වටා ඇති ලෝකය පිළිබඳව වඩාත් දක්ෂ වීමට ශිෂ් යයන් බල කරයි. "" ප් රේක්ෂකයින්ගේ උනන්දුව පෝෂණය කිරීමේ අවශ් යතාව සිසුන්ට බුද්ධිමත් හා සිත්ගන්නාසුළු වීමට පෙළඹවයි (ටෝටෝ, 2004). බ්ලොග්කරණය යනු සාම්ප් රදායික පාසල් දිනයෙන් ඔබ්බට ඉගෙනීම පුළුල් කිරීමට දිරිගන්වන මෙවලමකි. බ්ලොග් නිසි ලෙස භාවිතා කිරීම "" සිසුන්ට වඩාත් විශ්ලේෂණාත්මක හා විවේචාත්මක වීමට බල ගැන්විය හැකිය; අන්තර්ජාල ද් රව් යන්ට ක් රියාකාරීව ප් රතිචාර දැක්වීම තුළින්, සිසුන්ට අන් අයගේ ලේඛන සන්දර්ගයේ සන්දර්භය තුළ ඔවුන්ගේ ස්ථාවන් නිර්ව නිර්වචිත කිරීමට මෙන්ම විශේෂිත ගැටළු පිළිබඳ ඔවුන්ගේම දළඹු දර්ශනයන් දැක්විය හැකිය (Ocrave, 2002). "

flores_passage_en: "One of the most common methods used to illustrate the importance of socialization is to draw upon the few unfortunate cases of children who were, through neglect, misfortune, or wilful abuse, not socialized by adults while they were growing up. Such children are called ""feral"" or wild. Some feral children have been confined by people (usually their own parents); in some cases this child abandonment was due to the parents' rejection of a child's severe intellectual or physical impairment. Feral children may have experienced severe child abuse or trauma before being abandoned or running away. Others are alleged to have been brought up by animals; some are said to have lived in the wild on their own. When completely brought up by non-human animals, the feral child exhibits behaviors (within physical limits) almost entirely like those of the particular care-animal, such as its fear of or indifference to humans."
question_en: According to the passage, what is the primary reason some feral children were abandoned by their parents?
mc_answer1_en: The parents were unaware of the child's condition until later.
mc_answer2_en: The child had run away from home after experiencing trauma.
mc_answer3_en: The parents were unable to provide care because of extreme poverty.
mc_answer4_en: The parents had rejected the child due to severe intellectual or physical impairment.

flores_passage_en: "Technological determinism is a term that encompasses a wide range of ideas in practice, from technology-push or the technological imperative to a strict sense that human destiny is driven by an underlying logic associated with scientific laws and their manifestation in technology. Most interpretations of technological determinism share two general ideas: that the development of technology itself follows a path largely beyond cultural or political influence, and that technology in turn has ""effects"" on societies that are inherent, rather than socially conditioned. For example, one might say that the motor car necessarily leads to the development of roads. However, a nationwide road network is not economically viable for just a handful of cars, so new methods of production are developed to reduce the cost of car ownership. Mass car ownership also leads to a higher incidence of accidents on the roads, which leads to the invention of new techniques in healthcare for repairing damaged bodies."
question_en: According to the passage, which of the following sequences best represents the causal chain described in the example of the motor car?
mc_answer1_en: Mass car ownership → higher accident incidence → new healthcare techniques → reduced car ownership costs
mc_answer2_en: Development of roads → motor car necessity → mass production → economic viability

question: ඉදිරිපත් කරන ලද ප් රකාශය මත පදනම්ව, වර්තමාන තර්ජන තත්වය පිළිබඳ කථිකයාගේ තක්සේරුව වඩාත් තාර්කිකව සහාය දක්වන පහත සඳහන් නිගමන මොනවාද?

flores_passage_en: Twentieth century research has shown that there are two pools of genetic variation: hidden and expressed. Mutation adds new genetic variation, and selection removes it from the pool of expressed variation. Segregation and recombination shuffle variation back and forth between the two pools with each generation.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following conclusions is most strongly supported by the described mechanisms of genetic variation?
mc_answer1_en: Hidden genetic variation is always greater than expressed genetic variation.
mc_answer2_en: Selection eliminates all forms of genetic variation over time.
mc_answer3_en: Mutation and selection are the only processes that affect genetic variation.
mc_answer4_en: Genetic variation can be transferred between hidden and expressed pools through generational processes.

question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following conclusions about canyoning is most strongly supported?
mc_answer1_en: Canyoning involves significantly more technical skill than alpine skiing.
mc_answer2_en: Canyoning exclusively takes place in water-filled canyons.
mc_answer3_en: Canyoning is accessible to individuals with minimal prior training or physical conditioning.
mc_answer4_en: Canyoning requires participants to have advanced swimming and climbing certifications.

Chiao and Sharipov reported being a safe distance from the attitude adjustment thrusters. Russian ground control activated the jets and normal attitude of the station was regained.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following can be inferred about the relationship between the station's attitude loss and the subsequent thruster activation?

mc_answer3_en: The gyroscope failure caused the thrusters to malfunction, requiring manual intervention by the crew.
mc_answer4_en: The station's attitude was maintained without any intervention despite the gyroscope loss.

flores_passage_en: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior. For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following conclusions is most strongly supported by the relationship between racial stereotypes and academic performance?
mc_answer1_en: Racial stereotypes have no measurable impact on children's behavior or academic outcomes in real-world settings.
mc_answer2_en: Children who are aware of negative stereotypes about their racial group may experience reduced academic performance due to internalizing those stereotypes.
mc_answer3_en: Academic performance is solely determined by innate intelligence and is unaffected by social awareness or stereotypes.
mc_answer4_en: All children who identify with a minority race will inevitably perform poorly in school regardless of external influences.

question: මෙම ඡේදය මත පදනම්ව, පහත දැක්වෙන නිගමනයන්ගෙන් වඩාත්ම ශක්තිමත් ලෙස සහාය දක්වන්නේ ජනවාර්ගික ඒකාකෘති හා අධ් යයන කාර්ය සාධනය අතර සම්බන්ධතාවයයි?

mc_answer3: අධ් යයන කාර්ය සාධනය තනිකරම තීරණය වන්නේ සහජ බුද්ධියෙන් වන අතර එය සමාජ දැනුවත්භාවයට හෝ ඒකාකෘතභාවයට බලපාන්නේ නැත.

flores_passage_en: "Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau. These plateaus are often referred to as ""vidde"" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse. In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called ""hei"" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather."
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following best describes the relationship between 'vidde' and the geographical features of Norway's plateaus?
mc_answer1_en: Vidde is synonymous with the steep cliffs that drop suddenly from the high plateaus.
mc_answer2_en: Vidde describes the treeless moorland covered in heather found in Rogaland and Agder.
mc_answer3_en: Vidde is a term used exclusively for the steep fjords and valleys found in coastal Norway.
mc_answer4_en: Vidde refers to a wide, open treeless space that characterizes the high plateaus in Norway.

mc_answer1: වැඩි කාලයක් පවතින සුළි සුළං වඩාත් දරුණු හා විනාශකාරී විය හැකියි.
mc_answer2: පැය තුනකට වඩා පවතින සුළි කුණාටු වලින් සියයට 2ක් කෙටි කුණාටු වලට වඩා අඩු භයානකයි.
mc_answer3: සුළි කුණාටුවක සුළගේ වේගය එය ගොඩබිම කොපමණ කාලයක් රැඳී සිටිනවාද යන්න හා සම්බන්ධ නොවේ.
mc_answer4: බොහෝ සුළි සුළං ප් රතිශත දෙකට වඩා විනාශකාරී නමුත් ඒවා කෙටි කාලයක් පවතී.

flores_passage_en: "Hesperonychus elizabethae is a species of the family Dromaeosauridae and is a cousin of Velociraptor . This fully feathered, warm blooded bird of prey was believed to have walked upright on two legs with claws like the Velociraptor. Its second claw was larger, giving rise to the name Hesperonychus which means ""western claw."""
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following inferences about Hesperonychus elizabethae is most strongly supported by the evidence provided?
mc_answer1_en: It was fully feathered and warm-blooded, making it more similar to modern birds than to reptiles.
mc_answer2_en: Its name indicates a geographical origin related to the western region where fossils were found.
mc_answer3_en: It likely hunted smaller prey than Velociraptor due to its smaller size.
mc_answer4_en: The larger second claw suggests a specialized hunting adaptation similar to that of Velociraptor.
flores_passage: හෙස්පෙරොනික්ස් එලිසබෙත් (Hesperonychus elizabethae) යනු ඩ් රෝමියෝසොරයිඩී පවුලට අයත් විශේෂයක් වන අතර එය වේලෝසයිරැප්ටරයේ ඥාති සහෝදරයෙකි. මෙම පූර්ණ පිහාටු සහිත, උණුසුම් රුධිර සහිත දඩයම් කුරුල්ලා වේලෝසයිරැප්ටරය මෙන් නියපොතු සහිත කකුල් දෙකකින් කෙළින් ගමන් කළ බව විශ්වාස කෙරේ. එහි දෙවන නියපොතු විශාල වූ අතර "බටහිර නියපොතු" යන අර්ථය ඇති හෙස්පෙරොනික්ස් යන නම ඇති විය.
question: මෙම ඡේදය මත පදනම්ව, ලබා දී ඇති සාක්ෂි මගින් Hesperonychus elizabethae පිළිබඳ පහත සඳහන් නිගමන අතරින් වඩාත් තදින් සහාය වන්නේ කුමක්ද?
mc_answer1: එය සම්පූර්ණයෙන්ම පිහාටු සහිත සහ උණුසුම් රුධිරයෙන් යුක්ත වූ අතර එය උරගයින්ට වඩා වර්තමාන කුරුල්ලන්ට සමාන විය.
mc_answer2: එහි නම පෙන්නුම් කරන්නේ පොසිල සොයාගත් බටහිර කලාපයට සම්බන්ධ භූගෝලීය සම්භවයකි.
mc_answer3: එය බොහෝ විට වෙලෝසිරැප්ටරයට වඩා කුඩා ගොදුරු දඩයම් කර ඇත්තේ එහි කුඩා ප් රමාණය නිසාය.
mc_answer4: විශාලතම දෙවන නියපොත්තෙන් පෙන්නුම් කරන්නේ වේලෝසිරැප්ටර්ට සමාන විශේෂිත දඩයම් අනුවර්තනයක්.

flores_passage_en: The Hershey and Chase experiment was one of the leading suggestions that DNA was a genetic material. Hershey and Chase used phages, or viruses, to implant their own DNA into a bacterium. They did two experiments marking either the DNA in the phage with a radioactive phosphorus or the protein of the phage with radioactive sulfur.
question_en: Based on the Hershey and Chase experiment described, which of the following conclusions is most strongly supported by the observation that radioactive phosphorus (DNA marker) was found inside the bacterium while radioactive sulfur (protein marker) was not?
mc_answer1_en: The phage protein is responsible for transmitting genetic information to the bacterium.
mc_answer2_en: DNA, not protein, serves as the genetic material that is transmitted during infection.
mc_answer3_en: Radioactive sulfur is a more reliable marker than radioactive phosphorus for tracking viral components.
mc_answer4_en: Both DNA and protein enter the bacterium to contribute equally to genetic inheritance.
flores_passage: හර්ෂේ සහ චේස් අත්හදා බැලීම DNA ජානමය ද් රව් යයක් බවට ප් රමුඛ යෝජනා වලින් එකකි. හර්ෂේ සහ චේස් ඔවුන්ගේම ඩීඑන්ඒ බැක්ටීරියා තුළට රෝපණය කිරීම සඳහා ෆේජ හෝ වෛරස් භාවිතා කළහ. ඔවුන් අත්හදා බැලීම් දෙකක් කළේ ෆේජයේ ඩීඑන්ඒ විකිරණශීලී පොස්පරස් හෝ ෆේජයේ ප් රෝටීන් විකිරණශීලී සල්ෆර් සමඟ සලකුණු කිරීමෙනි.
question: හර්ෂි සහ චේස් විසින් විස්තර කරන ලද අත්හදා බැලීම මත පදනම්ව, විකිරණශීලී පොස්පරස් (ඩීඑන්ඒ සලකුණ) බැක්ටීරියා තුළ සොයාගත් අතර විකිරණශීලී සල්ෆර් (ප් රෝටීන් සලකුණ) නොතිබූ බව නිරීක්ෂණය කිරීමෙන් පහත සඳහන් නිගමනවලින් වඩාත් තදින් සහාය වන්නේ කුමක්ද?
mc_answer1: ෆේජ් ප් රෝටීනය බැක්ටීරියා වලට ජානමය තොරතුරු සම්ප් රේෂණය කිරීමේ වගකීම දරයි.
mc_answer2: ආසාදනය අතරතුර සම්ප් රේෂණය වන ජානමය ද් රව් ය වන්නේ ප් රෝටීන් නොව DNA ය.
mc_answer3: විකිරණශීලී සල්ෆර් යනු වෛරස් සංරචක සොයා ගැනීම සඳහා විකිරණශීලී පොස්පරස් වලට වඩා විශ්වාසදායක සලකුණකි.
mc_answer4: DNA සහ ප් රෝටීන් යන දෙකම බැක්ටීරියා තුළට ඇතුළු වී ජානමය උරුමයට සමානව දායක වේ.

flores_passage_en: A moderate earthquake shook western Montana at 10:08 p.m. on Monday. No immediate reports of damage have been received by the United States Geological Survey (USGS) and its National Earthquake Information Center. The earthquake was centered about 20 km (15 miles) north-northeast of Dillon, and about 65 km (40 miles) south of Butte.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following conclusions is most logically supported by the information provided?
mc_answer1_en: There was a high probability of significant damage in Dillon.
mc_answer2_en: The USGS has not yet determined the exact location of the epicenter.

flores_passage_en: Romanticism had a large element of cultural determinism, drawn from writers such as Goethe, Fichte, and Schlegel. In the context of Romanticism, the geography molded individuals, and over time customs and culture related to that geography arose, and these, being in harmony with the place of the society, were better than arbitrarily imposed laws.
question_en: According to the passage, what can be inferred about the relationship between geography and culture in Romanticism?
mc_answer1_en: Romanticism rejected the idea that geography influenced the formation of cultural norms.
mc_answer2_en: Writers like Goethe and Fichte argued that culture should be completely independent of geographical factors.
mc_answer3_en: Arbitrarily imposed laws are superior to customs because they ensure order and stability.
mc_answer4_en: Geography dictates the development of culture and customs that are naturally aligned with a society's needs.

question: මෙම ඡේදයට අනුව, රොමැන්ටිකවාදයේ භූගෝලීය විද් යාව සහ සංස්කෘතිය අතර සම්බන්ධය ගැන නිගමනය කළ හැක්කේ කුමක්ද?

mc_answer3_en: They avoid visiting parks to prevent disturbing natural ecosystems.
mc_answer4_en: Their engagement may involve active participation such as hunting or photography.

question: ස්වභාවධර්මයට නැඹුරු සංචාරකයන්ගේ අභිප් රේරණයන් ගැන පහත සඳහන් දේවලින් නිගමනය කළ හැක්කේ කුමක්ද?

flores_passage_en: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole. It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies. These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following can be logically inferred about the South Pole Traverse's route selection?
mc_answer1_en: Fuel supplies are transported using nimble vehicles for efficiency.
mc_answer2_en: The route avoids the most direct path due to vehicle limitations.
mc_answer3_en: The trail follows the natural contours of the Transantarctic Mountains.
mc_answer4_en: Flags are placed every kilometer to guide tractors through crevasses.

flores_passage_en: Former Massachusetts governor Mitt Romney won the Florida Republican Party presidential primary election on Tuesday with over 46 percent of the vote. Former U.S. Speaker of the House Newt Gingrich came in second with 32 percent. As a winner-takes-all state, Florida awarded all fifty of its delegates to Romney, pushing him ahead as the front-runner for the Republican Party nomination.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following can be inferred about the impact of Florida's primary results on the Republican nomination race?
mc_answer1_en: Florida's primary had no effect on the overall delegate count since other states still hold primaries.
mc_answer2_en: Gingrich's second-place finish indicates he is now the leading candidate for the nomination.

As the areas are sparsely populated, and light pollution therefore often not a problem, you will also be able to enjoy the stars.
question_en: Which of the following conclusions is best supported by the passage regarding the optimal conditions for stargazing in polar regions during winter?
mc_answer1_en: The Aurora borealis and stargazing are equally difficult to observe in polar regions due to extreme cold and limited daylight hours.
mc_answer2_en: The darkness caused by the polar night, combined with minimal light pollution, creates favorable conditions for observing celestial phenomena.
mc_answer3_en: Sparse population in polar regions ensures that the Aurora borealis is always visible regardless of the time of year or light conditions.
mc_answer4_en: Visitors must travel during the polar night specifically because the Aurora borealis is only visible when the sun is below the horizon.

flores_passage_en: Across the United States of America, there are approximately 400,000 known cases of Multiple Sclerosis (MS), leaving it as the leading neurological disease in younger and middle aged adults. MS is a disease that affects the central nervous system, which is made up of the brain, the spinal cord and the optic nerve. Research has found that females are two times more likely to have MS then males.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following statements is most strongly supported by the information provided regarding Multiple Sclerosis?
mc_answer1_en: There are more known cases of Multiple Sclerosis in males than in females across the United States.
mc_answer2_en: The optic nerve is the only part of the central nervous system affected by Multiple Sclerosis.
mc_answer3_en: Females are at a higher risk of developing Multiple Sclerosis compared to males.
mc_answer4_en: Multiple Sclerosis is the most common neurological disease among all age groups in the United States.

flores_passage_en: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches. The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest. Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following statements can be logically inferred about the role of human activity in avalanche occurrence?
mc_answer1_en: Human activity is the most frequent cause of avalanches compared to natural triggers.
mc_answer2_en: Human activity can act as one of several potential triggering events for avalanches.
mc_answer3_en: Avalanches would not occur without human intervention in any way.
mc_answer4_en: Natural events like sunlight and snowfall are less effective than humans in triggering avalanches.

flores_passage_en: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a flush toilet in almost every house, attached to a sophisticated sewage system. Remains of sewage systems have been found in the houses of the Minoan cities of Crete and Santorini in Greece. There were also toilets in ancient Egypt, Persia and China. In Roman civilization, toilets were sometimes part of public bath houses where men and women were together in mixed company.
question_en: Which of the following conclusions is best supported by the passage regarding ancient sanitation practices?
mc_answer1_en: Toilet facilities were exclusively reserved for public spaces in ancient Rome.
mc_answer2_en: Flush toilets were invented solely in the Indus Valley cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro.
mc_answer3_en: Private households in ancient Egypt lacked any form of toilet system.
mc_answer4_en: Ancient civilizations prioritized hygiene through advanced plumbing infrastructure.

flores_passage_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots. Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry. A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.
question_en: Which of the following conclusions is most logically supported by the passage regarding the Assyrian cavalry's combat effectiveness despite the absence of saddles?
mc_answer1_en: Assyrian cavalrymen could fight on horseback without saddles because they had mastered advanced equestrian skills that compensated for the lack of equipment.
mc_answer2_en: The use of crossbows by the Assyrian cavalry allowed them to penetrate armor more effectively than infantry soldiers using spears.
