flores_passage_en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so. If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it. If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required. Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.
question_en: According to the passage, what would be the most appropriate action if someone had not checked the specific filming regulations and permits required before using a drone?
mc_answer1_en: They should cancel or delay the drone filming until they have verified the allowed areas and necessary permits.
mc_answer2_en: They should record a video anyway, since video recording rules are less strict than photography rules.
mc_answer3_en: They should fly the drone near an airport to test the regulations, as this is a good practice for understanding local laws.
mc_answer4_en: They should proceed with filming, assuming that general rules for photography would suffice.
flores_passage: සාමාන් ය ඡායාරූපකරණයට අදාළ නීති රීති වීඩියෝ පටිගත කිරීම සඳහා ද අදාළ වේ. සමහර විට ඊටත් වඩා. යම් දෙයක් ඡායාරූප ගත කිරීම පමණක් අවසර නැති නම්, ඔබ ඒ පිළිබඳ වීඩියෝ පටිගත කිරීම ගැන සිතා බැලිය යුතු නැත. ඩ් රෝන් යානයක් භාවිතා කරන්නේ නම්, ඔබට රූගත කිරීමට අවසර ඇති දේ සහ අවශ් ය බලපත් ර හෝ අමතර බලපත් ර මොනවාද යන්න කල්තියාම පරීක්ෂා කරන්න. ගුවන් තොටුපළක් අසල හෝ සමූහයක් මත ඩ් රෝන් යානයක් පියාසර කිරීම සෑම විටම පාහේ නරක අදහසකි, එය ඔබේ ප් රදේශයේ නීති විරෝධී නොවූවත්.
question: මෙම ඡේදයට අනුව, යමෙකු ඩ් රෝන් යානයක් භාවිතා කිරීමට පෙර අවශ් ය නිශ්චිත රූගත කිරීමේ රෙගුලාසි සහ බලපත් ර පරීක්ෂා කර නොමැති නම් වඩාත් සුදුසු ක් රියාමාර්ගය කුමක්ද?
mc_answer1: ඔවුන් අවසර ලත් ප් රදේශ සහ අවශ් ය බලපත් ර තහවුරු කරන තුරු ඩ් රෝන් රූගත කිරීම් අවලංගු කිරීම හෝ ප් රමාද කිරීම කළ යුතුය.
mc_answer2: වීඩියෝ පටිගත කිරීමේ නීතිරීති ඡායාරූපකරණයේ නීතිරීති වලට වඩා අඩු බැවින් ඔවුන් වීඩියෝ පටිගත කළ යුතුය.
mc_answer3: ඔවුන් ගුවන් තොටුපල අසල ඩ් රෝන් යානය පියාසර කළ යුතුයි රෙගුලාසි පරීක්ෂා කරන්න, මෙය දේශීය නීති තේරුම් ගැනීමට හොඳ පුරුද්දක්.
mc_answer4: ඡායාරූපකරණය සඳහා පොදු නීති ප් රමාණවත් යැයි උපකල්පනය කරමින් ඔවුන් රූගත කිරීම් ආරම්භ කළ යුතුය.

flores_passage_en: The Twin Otter had been trying to land at Kokoda yesterday as Airlines PNG Flight CG4684, but had aborted once already. About ten minutes before it was due to land from its second approach it disapeared. The crash site was located today and is so inaccessable that two policemen were dropped into the jungle in order to hike to the scene and seek survivors. The search had been hampered by the same bad weather that had caused the aborted landing.
question_en: If the weather had not been bad, what would most likely have been the outcome of the Twin Otter's second approach?
mc_answer1_en: The plane would have landed but the search team would still have been sent to investigate a minor incident.
mc_answer2_en: The plane would have landed successfully and no search for survivors would have been necessary.
mc_answer3_en: The plane would have aborted the landing a third time regardless of weather conditions.
mc_answer4_en: The plane would have crashed anyway because the pilot was inexperienced.

question: කාලගුණය නරක නොවුණා නම්, නිවුන් ඔටර්ගේ දෙවන ප් රවේශයේ ප් රතිඵලය කුමක් විය හැකිද?

mc_answer2: ගුවන් යානය සාර්ථකව ගොඩබසිනු ඇති අතර දිවි ගලවා ගත් අය සෙවීම අවශ් ය නොවනු ඇත.
mc_answer3: ගුවන් යානය තෙවන වරටත් ගොඩබෑම අත්හිටුවනු ඇත කාලගුණ තත්ත්වය කුමක් වුවත්.
mc_answer4: ගුවන් යානය කොහොමත් කඩා වැටෙන්න තිබ්බා මොකද නියමුවා අද්දැකීම් නැති නිසා.

flores_passage_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman. The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile. A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake. The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.
question_en: If King Yasovarman had not built the Phnom Krom temple at the end of the 9th century, which of the following outcomes would most likely have occurred according to the passage's implied context?
mc_answer1_en: The climb to the hill would still be considered worthwhile due to the lake view.
mc_answer2_en: Visitors would not need to bring their passport for the temple entry.

flores_passage_en: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change. Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same. Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom. It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid. Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.
question_en: According to the passage, what would likely happen to the chemical properties of nitrogen if it were to transition from a liquid state back to a gaseous state, assuming no external chemical reactions occurred?
mc_answer1_en: The chemical properties would become identical to those of water vapor due to shared atomic composition.
mc_answer2_en: The chemical properties would remain the same as they are in the liquid state.
mc_answer3_en: The chemical properties would change because the molecules would rearrange into a different compound.
mc_answer4_en: The chemical properties would become less dense and lose their molecular structure.

flores_passage_en: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci. question_en: If Marshal Italo Balbo had not been killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk on June 28, 1940, which of the following outcomes is most likely based on the passage's description of the Italian situation in North Africa?

mc_answer2_en: The Italian Tenth Army's morale and leadership structure might have been preserved, potentially altering early campaign dynamics.

flores_passage_en: Red tide is caused by a higher than normal concentration of Karenia brevis, a naturally-occurring single-celled marine organism. Natural factors can intersect to produce ideal conditions, allowing this algae to increase in number dramatically. The algae produces a neurotoxin that can disable nerves in both humans and fish. Fish often die because of the high concentrations of the toxin in the waters. Humans can be affected by breathing affected water taken into the air by wind and waves.
question_en: If natural factors had not intersected to produce ideal conditions for Karenia brevis, which of the following would most likely have occurred regarding human health impacts from red tide?
mc_answer1_en: Humans would have been unaffected by red tide neurotoxins because the algae would not have increased in number dramatically.
mc_answer2_en: Fish would have died despite the absence of ideal conditions due to natural concentrations of Karenia brevis.
mc_answer3_en: Wind and waves would have dispersed neurotoxins more effectively, reducing human exposure even without ideal conditions.
mc_answer4_en: The neurotoxin would have remained harmless to both fish and humans regardless of algae concentration.

flores_passage_en: The Babylonians built each of their gods a primary temple that was considered the home of the god. People would bring sacrifices to the gods and the priests would try to attend to the needs of the gods through ceremonies and festivals. Each temple had an open temple courtyard and then an inner sanctuary that only the priests could enter. Sometimes special pyramid shaped towers, called ziggurats, were built to be a part of the temples. The top of the tower was special sanctuary for the god.
question_en: If the priests had not been allowed to enter the inner sanctuary of the temple, what would most likely have been the consequence?
mc_answer1_en: The ziggurats would have been built as open-air courtyards instead.
mc_answer2_en: The ceremonies and festivals would have been disrupted or incomplete.
mc_answer3_en: The gods would have received no sacrifices from the people.
mc_answer4_en: The primary temple would have been converted into a public marketplace.

flores_passage_en: "The ""up bow"" mark looks like a V and the ""down bow mark"" like a staple or a square missing its bottom side. flores_passage_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand. flores_passage_en: The Plitvice Lakes national park is heavily forested, mainly with beech, spruce, and fir trees, and features a mixture of Alpine and Mediterranean vegetation. It has a notably wide variety of plant communities, due to its range of microclimates, differing soils and varying levels of altitude. The area is also home to an extremely wide variety of animal and bird species. Rare fauna such as the European brown bear, wolf, eagle, owl, lynx, wild cat and capercaillie can be found there, along with many more common species
question_en: If the Plitvice Lakes national park had not been heavily forested with beech, spruce, and fir trees, which of the following would most likely have been impacted according to the passage?
mc_answer1_en: The area would have supported fewer rare animal species due to reduced habitat diversity.
mc_answer2_en: The park would have lacked the mixture of Alpine and Mediterranean vegetation described.
mc_answer3_en: The altitude levels across the park would have been altered to favor only Mediterranean species.
mc_answer4_en: The range of microclimates and varying soil levels would have changed significantly.

flores_passage_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria. They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List. Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea. Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

mc_answer1_en: The villages would have been accessible by cars from the outside.
mc_answer2_en: The paths, trains, and boats would have been replaced by a different transportation system.
mc_answer3_en: The villages would have lacked the distinctive charm that comes from their unique terraced landscape.
mc_answer4_en: The villages would have been removed from the UNESCO World Heritage List.

flores_passage_en: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole. Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea. A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter. Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice. Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.
question_en: If the summer season (Nov-Feb) were unavailable for tourist visits to Antarctica, which of the following would most likely be true based on the passage?
mc_answer1_en: The large base at the Pole would become inaccessible to all visitors.
mc_answer2_en: Tourist visits would be limited to specialist air tours only.
mc_answer3_en: Staff living in the bases would no longer be needed during the year.
mc_answer4_en: Inland Antarctica would see a surge in mountaineering expeditions.

flores_passage_en: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that. Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter. For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel. The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.
question_en: According to the passage, what would most likely happen if a traveler decided to engage in begging to reduce expenses?
mc_answer1_en: The traveler would violate the article's core ethical assumptions.
mc_answer2_en: The traveler would be exempt from sacrificing comfort and time.
mc_answer3_en: The traveler would successfully achieve minimum budget travel.
mc_answer4_en: The traveler would be encouraged to participate in the illegal market.

mc_answer2_en: Apples would likely remain the primary fruit used in pastries throughout the year.

flores_passage_en: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings. An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites. A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person. Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases. These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.
question_en: If a government had not required vaccination for visitors entering their country, what would most likely have occurred based on the passage's definition of infectious diseases?
mc_answer1_en: The distinction between infectious and contagious diseases would have become irrelevant.
mc_answer2_en: Governments would have stopped tracking which countries travelers visited.
mc_answer3_en: Travelers with infectious diseases could have entered the country without restriction, potentially spreading pathogens like viruses or bacteria.
mc_answer4_en: All contagious diseases would have automatically been eliminated from the population.

flores_passage_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus. According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded. The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born. Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.
question_en: If the Ephesians had decided to record Herostratus' name immediately after the arson, what would be the most likely consequence regarding the historical record of the event?
mc_answer1_en: Alexander the Great would have refused to offer to rebuild the temple.
mc_answer2_en: Herostratus would have been honored for his act instead of being remembered for his infamy.
mc_answer3_en: His name would be better known today, and Strabo might not have been needed to preserve it.
mc_answer4_en: The temple would have been rebuilt immediately without waiting for Alexander's offer.

mc_answer2: හොඳම චිත් රපටය සහ අධ් යක්ෂකවරයා වැනි අනෙකුත් නාමයෝජනා ඉවත් කරනු ලැබේ.
mc_answer3: රයන් ගොස්ලිං සහ එමා ස්ටෝන් පිළිවෙලින් හොඳම නළුවා සහ හොඳම නිළිය සඳහා නාමයෝජනා ලබා නොගනු ඇත.
mc_answer4: චිත් රපටයේ ගීත දෙකකට හොඳම මුල් ගීතය සඳහා නාමයෝජනා ලැබෙන්නේ නැහැ.

flores_passage_en: """Panama Papers"" is an umbrella term for roughly ten million documents from Panamanian law firm Mossack Fonseca, leaked to the press in spring 2016. The documents showed fourteen banks helped wealthy clients hide billions of US dollars of wealth to avoid taxes and other regulations. British newspaper The Guardian suggested Deutsche Bank controlled roughly a third of the 1200 shell companies used to accomplish this. There were protests worldwide, several criminal prosecutions, and the leaders of the governments of Iceland and Pakistan both resigned."
question_en: According to the passage, what would most likely have been different if the 'Panama Papers' had not been leaked to the press in spring 2016?
mc_answer1_en: Deutsche Bank would have controlled a smaller portion of the shell companies.
mc_answer2_en: The leaked documents would not have shown fourteen banks helping clients hide wealth.
mc_answer3_en: Worldwide protests against tax avoidance would not have occurred.
mc_answer4_en: The leaders of the governments of Iceland and Pakistan would not have resigned.

question: මෙම ඡේදයට අනුව, 2016 වසන්තයේ දී 'පැනමා ලේඛන' මාධ් යයට කාන්දු නොවී නම් බොහෝ දුරට වෙනස් වන්නේ කුමක් ද?

mc_answer2: කාන්දු වුනු ලිපි ලේඛන මගින් පෙන්වන්නේ නැහැ බැංකු 14ක් සේවාදායකයින්ට ධනය සඟවන්න උදව් කරනවා කියලා.
mc_answer3: බදු පැහැර හැරීමට එරෙහිව ලෝක ව් යාප්ත විරෝධතා ඇති නොවනු ඇත.
mc_answer4: අයිස්ලන්තයේ සහ පාකිස්තානයේ රජයන්ගේ නායකයින් ඉල්ලා අස්වෙන්නේ නැහැ.

flores_passage_en: Soon after the outbreak of hostilities, Britain initiated a naval blockade of Germany. The strategy proved effective, cutting off vital military and civilian supplies, although this blockade violated generally accepted international law codified by several international agreements of the past two centuries. Britain mined international waters to prevent any ships from entering entire sections of ocean, causing danger to even neutral ships. Since there was limited response to this tactic, Germany expected a similar response to its unrestricted submarine warfare.
question_en: If Britain had not initiated the naval blockade of Germany after the outbreak of hostilities, which of the following would most likely have been true regarding Germany's expectations about international law and naval tactics?
mc_answer1_en: Germany would have anticipated Britain would continue to adhere to international law despite the blockade.
mc_answer2_en: Germany would have likely avoided adopting unrestricted submarine warfare, fearing a similar blockade response from Britain.
mc_answer3_en: Germany would have likely adopted unrestricted submarine warfare regardless, as its strategy was independent of Britain's blockade.
mc_answer4_en: Germany would have expected Britain to respect neutral ships in international waters, leading to more cooperation.
flores_passage: සතුරු ක් රියා ආරම්භ වූ වහාම බ් රිතාන් යය ජර්මනියට නාවික අවහිර කිරීමක් ආරම්භ කළේය. මෙම උපායමාර්ගය සාර්ථක බව ඔප්පු වූ අතර අත් යවශ් ය මිලිටරි හා සිවිල් සැපයුම් කපා හැරියේය. මෙම අවහිර කිරීම පසුගිය සියවස් දෙක තුළ ජාත් යන්තර ගිවිසුම් කිහිපයකින් සංග් රහ කර ඇති පොදුවේ පිළිගත් ජාත් යන්තර නීතිය උල්ලංඝනය කළද. බ් රිතාන් යය ජාත් යන්තර මුහුදේ බෝම්බ දැමුවේ ඕනෑම නැවක් සාගරයේ මුළු කොටස් වලට ඇතුළු වීම වළක්වා ගැනීම සඳහා වන අතර එමඟින් මධ් යස්ථ නැව්වලට පවා අනතුරක් ඇති විය. මෙම උපක් රමයට සීමිත ප් රතිචාරයක් ඇති වූ බැවින් ජර්මනිය සිය සීමා රහිත සබ්මැරීන් යුද්ධයට සමාන ප් රතිචාරයක් අපේක්ෂා කළේය.
question: බ් රිතාන් යය ජර්මනියට එරෙහිව නාවික අවහිර කිරීම ආරම්භ නොකළේ නම්, ජාත් යන්තර නීතිය හා නාවික උපක් රම පිළිබඳ ජර්මනියේ අපේක්ෂාවන් සම්බන්ධයෙන් පහත සඳහන් දේවලින් වඩාත්ම සත් ය විය හැක්කේ කුමක්ද?
mc_answer1: ජර්මනිය අපේක්ෂා කළා බ් රිතාන් යය දිගටම ජාත් යන්තර නීතියට අනුගත වේවි කියලා අවහිර කිරීම තිබියදීත්.
mc_answer2: ජර්මනිය සීමා රහිත සබ්මැරීන් යුද්ධය අනුගමනය කිරීමෙන් වැළකී සිටීමට ඉඩ තිබුණි, බ් රිතාන් යයෙන් සමාන අවහිර කිරීමේ ප් රතිචාරයක් ගැන බියෙන්.
mc_answer3: ජර්මනිය සීමා රහිත සබ්මැරීන් යුද්ධය අනුගමනය කරනු ඇත, මන්ද එහි උපායමාර්ගය බ් රිතාන් යයේ අවහිරයෙන් ස්වාධීන බැවිනි.
mc_answer4: ජර්මනිය අපේක්ෂා කරනවා බ් රිතාන් යයට ජාත් යන්තර මුහුදු සීමාවන්හි මධ් යස්ථ නෞකාවන්ට ගරු කිරීමට, වැඩි සහයෝගීතාවයක් ඇති කිරීමට.

flores_passage_en: The United States Geological Survey international earthquake map showed no earthquakes in Iceland in the week prior. The Icelandic Meteorological Office also reported no earthquake activity in the Hekla area in the past 48 hours. The significant earthquake activity resulting in the phase change had took place on March 10 on the northeast side of the volcano's summit caldera. Dark clouds unrelated to any volcanic activity were reported at the base of the mountain. The clouds presented the potential for confusion as to whether an actual eruption had taken place.
question_en: If the significant earthquake activity on March 10 had not occurred, which of the following would most likely have been true regarding the phase change and public perception of an eruption?
mc_answer1_en: The phase change would not have happened, and the dark clouds would not have caused confusion about an eruption.
mc_answer2_en: The dark clouds would have been immediately recognized as unrelated to volcanic activity, preventing any confusion.
mc_answer3_en: The phase change would have still occurred due to other factors, but the dark clouds would not have been reported.

flores_passage_en: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others. It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information. In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998) The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times. Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.
question_en: Based on the passage, if asynchronous communication were not available to students, which of the following consequences would most likely occur?
mc_answer1_en: Students would be unable to access information at any time of day.
mc_answer2_en: Students would lose the ability to control the pace of instructional information.
mc_answer3_en: Students would be forced to wait until the next face-to-face meeting to submit questions to instructors.
mc_answer4_en: Instructors would no longer be able to provide reasonably quick responses to student inquiries.

mc_answer1: සිසුන්ට දවසේ ඕනෑම වේලාවක තොරතුරු ලබා ගැනීමට නොහැකි වනු ඇත.
mc_answer2: අධ් යාපනික තොරතුරු පාලනය කිරීමේ හැකියාව සිසුන්ට අහිමි වනු ඇත.
mc_answer3: ගුරුවරුන්ට ප් රශ්න යොමු කරන්න ශිෂ් යයන්ට ඊළඟ රැස්වීම වෙනකල් ඉන්න වෙනවා.
mc_answer4: ගුරුවරුන්ට තවදුරටත් ශිෂ් යයන්ගේ විමසීම් වලට ප් රමාණවත් තරම් ඉක්මන් ප් රතිචාර දැක්වීමට නොහැකි වනු ඇත.

flores_passage_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others. That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire. Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions. For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car. He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.
question_en: If the person breaking the car window had not lost their car keys and it was actually their own car, how would the passage suggest observers would interpret the action?
mc_answer1_en: They would assume the person was practicing self-defense against an intruder.
mc_answer2_en: They would assume the person was trying to retrieve keys from inside the car.
mc_answer3_en: They would assume the person was attempting to break the window for no reason.
mc_answer4_en: They would assume the person was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

question: මෝටර් රථයේ ජනේලය බිඳ දැමූ පුද්ගලයා තම මෝටර් රථයේ යතුරු නැති කර නොගෙන ඇත්ත වශයෙන්ම තමන්ගේම මෝටර් රථයක් නම්, මෙම ඡේදය නිරීක්ෂකයින් එම ක් රියාව අර්ථ නිරූපණය කරන්නේ කෙසේද?

mc_answer2: එයාලා අනුමාන කරනවා ඒ පුද්ගලයා කාර් එකේ යතුරු ගන්න හදනවා කියලා.

flores_passage_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain. Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak. But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel. However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.
question_en: If the British Army had not lost most of its heavy weapons and supplies at Dunkirk, what would most likely have been the outcome of the planned German invasion of Britain?
mc_answer1_en: The Germans would have been forced to abandon the invasion plan entirely.
mc_answer2_en: The Royal Navy would have had no reason to avoid the invasion routes.
mc_answer3_en: The invasion would have been easily repelled due to stronger British ground defenses.
mc_answer4_en: The outcome of the invasion would have been more uncertain, but the Royal Navy's role would have remained decisive.

question: බ් රිතාන් ය හමුදාව ඩන්කර්ක්හිදී තම බර අවි සහ සැපයුම් බොහොමයක් අහිමි නොකළේ නම්, බ් රිතාන් යයට සැලසුම් කළ ජර්මානු ආක් රමණයේ ප් රතිඵලය කුමක් විය හැකිද?
mc_answer1: ජර්මානුවන්ට ආක් රමණික සැලැස්ම මුළුමනින්ම අත්හැර දැමීමට සිදුවනු ඇත.

flores_passage_en: "The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean. It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean. With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as ""Hawaii down under"". Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development. The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki."
question_en: If the Cook Islands had not developed any large tourist hotels, which of the following statements would most accurately reflect a likely consequence based on the passage's description of the islands' character?

mc_answer4_en: The islands would be forced to establish cities to accommodate tourists.

mc_answer3_en: Sanskrit would have been written in Latin instead of its original form

flores_passage_en: News spread in the Red Lake community today as funerals for Jeff Weise and three of the nine victims were held that another student was arrested in connection with the school shootings of March 21. Authorities said little officially beyond confirming today's arrest. However, a source with knowledge of the investigation told the Minneapolis Star-Tribune that it was Louis Jourdain, 16-year old son of Red Lake Tribal Chairman Floyd Jourdain. It is not known at this time what charges will be laid or what led authorities to the boy but juvenile proceedings have begun in federal court.
question_en: If the arrest of Louis Jourdain had not occurred, what would most likely have been the immediate consequence for the Red Lake community based on the passage?
mc_answer1_en: Louis Jourdain would have faced immediate charges in federal court.
mc_answer2_en: Funerals for Jeff Weise and three victims would have been delayed.
mc_answer3_en: Authorities would have officially confirmed the identity of the suspect.

flores_passage_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states. flores_passage_en: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen states first formed a weak central government—with the Congress being its only component—under the Articles of Confederation. Congress lacked any power to impose taxes, and, because there was no national executive or judiciary, it relied on state authorities, who were often uncooperative, to enforce all its acts. It also had no authority to override tax laws and tariffs between states. The Articles required unanimous consent from all the states before they could be amended and states took the central government so lightly that their representatives were often absent.
question_en: If the Articles of Confederation had been easily amendable, what would most likely have been a direct consequence of this change, based on the passage's description of the government's structural weaknesses?
mc_answer1_en: The central government could have adapted its rules to address enforcement issues and interstate conflicts more effectively.
mc_answer2_en: State representatives would have attended congressional sessions more consistently due to increased influence.
mc_answer3_en: A national executive branch would have been automatically established to enforce laws.
mc_answer4_en: The central government would have gained the power to impose taxes without state approval.

flores_passage_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots. Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous. These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves. A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk. Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.
question_en: What would have been the most likely outcome for Triceratops if cycads had not been a common plant in the Cretaceous period?
mc_answer1_en: They would have relied more on their beaks to strip leaves from other tough plants, but their diet would have remained unchanged.
mc_answer2_en: They would have needed to adapt their feeding strategies to consume different plants that were available at the time.
mc_answer3_en: They would have been forced to eat only the leaves of cycads, even though the trunks were more nutritious.
mc_answer4_en: They would have avoided eating cycads entirely due to the risk of poisoning from other plants.

question: ට් රයිසෙරැටොප්ස් සඳහා ඇති විය හැකි ප් රතිඵලය කුමක්ද? ක් රිටේසියස් යුගයේ සයිකැඩ්ස් පොදු ශාකයක් නොවූයේ නම්?

flores_passage_en: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock. Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly. Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize. Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna. If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.
question_en: If a traveler had not splurged on Western-style hotels and food during their initial days in a developing country, what would most likely be the consequence according to the passage?
mc_answer1_en: They would have avoided culture shock entirely due to better budget management.
mc_answer2_en: They might have been overwhelmed by the newness of the environment and struggled with cultural adjustments.
mc_answer3_en: They would have acclimatized more quickly by embracing local customs immediately.

flores_passage_en: While project based learning should make learning easier and more interesting, scaffolding goes a step beyond. Scaffolds can be both virtual and real, in other words, a teacher is a form of scaffold but so is the little paperclip man in Microsoft Office. Virtual Scaffolds are internalized in the software and are meant to question, prompt, and explain procedures that may have been to challenging for the student to handle alone.
question_en: According to the passage, if scaffolding were not used in a new learning experience, what would most likely be the outcome?
mc_answer1_en: The learning experience would become more interesting but less effective, as scaffolding makes learning difficult.
mc_answer2_en: Students might struggle with procedures that are too challenging to handle alone, as scaffolds provide necessary support.
mc_answer3_en: Students would be unable to learn any new material at all, as scaffolding is the only way to learn.

question: මෙම ඡේදයට අනුව, යුද්ධය ආරම්භ වීමට පෙර ඉතාලිය නව නැව් හතරක් ඉදි නොකළේ නම්, ඔවුන්ගේ අප් රිකානු ව් යාපාර සැලසුම් සඳහා ඇති විය හැකි ප් රතිවිපාකය කුමක්ද?
mc_answer1: ඉතාලිය සිය අවධානය යොමු කරන්නේ අප් රිකානු ජාතීන් වෙනුවට යුරෝපීය රටවල් අල්ලා ගැනීමටයි.
mc_answer2: ඉතාලියට මධ් යධරණී මුහුද හරහා යාත් රා කර හමුදා පිටත් කර යැවීමට නොහැකි වනු ඇත.
mc_answer3: ඉතාලි නාවික හමුදාව ඊටත් වඩා දුර්වලයි, ඊජිප්තුවේ බ් රිතාන් ය කඳවුරු නිෂ්ක් රීය කිරීම දුෂ්කර කරයි.
mc_answer4: ජපානයට ඉතාලියේ භූමිකාව භාර ගන්නට සිදුවනු ඇත මධ් යධරණි කලාපයේ.

flores_passage_en: The work done was mostly theoretical, but the program was written to simulate observations made of the Sagittarius galaxy. The effect the team was looking for would be caused by tidal forces between the galaxy's dark matter and the Milky Way's dark matter. Just like the moon exerts a pull on the earth, causing tides, so does the Milky Way exert a force on the Sagittarius galaxy. The scientists were able to conclude that the dark matter affect other dark matter in the same way regular matter does. This theory says that most dark matter around a galaxy is located around a galaxy in a kind of halo, and is made of lots of small particles.
question_en: If the Milky Way had not exerted a gravitational force on the Sagittarius galaxy, which of the following outcomes would most likely have been observed by the team?
mc_answer1_en: The simulated observations would have shown no tidal forces affecting the distribution of dark matter particles.
mc_answer2_en: The scientists would have concluded that dark matter particles only interact with regular matter.
mc_answer3_en: The dark matter halo around the Sagittarius galaxy would have been more compact and dense.
mc_answer4_en: The program would have been unable to simulate any observations of the Sagittarius galaxy.

question: තාරකා මණ්ඩලයේ ගුරුත්වාකර්ෂණ බලයක් නොතිබුනේ නම්, පෘථිවියේ තාරකා මණ්ඩලයේ ගුරුත්වාකර්ෂණ බලයක් නොතිබුනේ නම්, පර්යේෂක කණ්ඩායම බොහෝ විට නිරීක්ෂණය කරනු ඇත්තේ පහත සඳහන් ප් රතිඵලවලින් කුමන එකද?
mc_answer1: අනුකරණය කරන ලද නිරීක්ෂණ මගින් අඳුරු පදාර්ථ අංශු බෙදා හැරීමට බලපාන කිසිදු උදම් බලයක් නොපෙන්වනු ඇත.

flores_passage_en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps. At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient. The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures. Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole. Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.
question_en: If a pedestrian had not worn footwear with suitable soles during a winter storm, which of the following outcomes is most likely based on the passage?
mc_answer1_en: The pedestrian would have walked more quickly to avoid the slippery conditions.
mc_answer2_en: The pedestrian would have been protected by the salt scattered on the roads.
mc_answer3_en: The pedestrian would have likely slipped on icy steps due to inadequate traction.

flores_passage_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences. Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history. International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants. Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not. These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following best describes a counterfactual consequence if International Horticultural Expositions were held annually in the same country instead of different countries?
mc_answer1_en: The requirement for sites to be no smaller than 50 hectares would likely be waived to accommodate repeated use.
mc_answer2_en: The duration of the exposition would automatically shorten to one month to reduce costs.
mc_answer3_en: Participating countries would be required to present only artistic displays rather than educational ones.
mc_answer4_en: The logistical strain on the host country's infrastructure and resources would likely increase significantly over time.

flores_passage_en: The first cases of the disease this season were reported in late July. The disease is carried by pigs, which then migrates to humans through mosquitos. The outbreak has prompted the Indian government to undertake such measures as deployment of pig catchers in seriously affected areas, distributing thousands of mosquito curtains and spraying pesticides. Several million vials of encephalitis vaccine have also been promised by the government, which will help prepare health agencies for next year. Plans for vaccines to be delivered to the historically most affected areas this year were delayed due to lack of funds and low prioritisation relative to other diseases.
question_en: If the Indian government had not delayed the vaccine delivery plans due to lack of funds and low prioritisation, what would most likely have been the consequence for the historically most affected areas this year?
mc_answer1_en: They would have received the vaccine doses earlier than planned, but the outbreak would have worsened due to increased mosquito activity.
mc_answer2_en: They would have received the vaccine doses earlier than planned, but the health agencies would have been unable to prepare for next year.
mc_answer3_en: They would have received the vaccine doses earlier than planned, but the government would have had to cancel the pig catcher deployment.

flores_passage_en: Muhammad was deeply interested in matters beyond this mundane life. Resting on the top of one of the mountains north of Mecca, the cave is completely isolated from the rest of the world. In fact, it is not easy to find at all even if one knew it existed. flores_passage_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana. The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay. In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic. You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls. On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!
question_en: If the rainy season had not occurred this year, what would most likely be the impact on a tourist's experience at Victoria Falls?
mc_answer1_en: Tourists would be unable to visit the town due to dangerous flooding conditions.
mc_answer2_en: Tourists would be more likely to get wet while crossing the bridge or walking along the trails.
mc_answer3_en: Tourists would find the adventure activities more appealing due to increased water volume.
mc_answer4_en: Tourists would have a clearer view of the actual Falls but might find the scenery less dramatic.

flores_passage_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king. Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration. Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible. The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo. Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.
question_en: According to the passage, if Howard Carter had not discovered the tomb of Tutankhamun in 1922, which of the following would most likely be true?
mc_answer1_en: The treasures from the tomb would have been automatically transferred to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.
mc_answer2_en: The mummy's head and shoulders would have been more visible than in the actual historical record.
mc_answer3_en: The tomb would remain undiscovered and the royal burial would not be known to the public in the modern era.
mc_answer4_en: Visitors would have been advised to spend their time elsewhere even if the tomb were discovered.

mc_answer1: සොහොන් ගෙයින් නිධානයන් ස්වයංක් රීයව කයිරෝහි ඊජිප්තු කෞතුකාගාරයට මාරු කරනු ලැබේ.
mc_answer2: මෘත ශරීරයේ හිස සහ උරහිස් ඇත්තම ඉතිහාස වාර්තාවට වඩා පැහැදිලිව පෙනෙන්නට ඇත.
mc_answer3: මෙම සොහොන් ගෙය සොයා නොගෙන පවතිනු ඇති අතර රාජකීය භූමදානය නූතන යුගයේ මහජනතාවට නොදැනේ.
mc_answer4: අමුත්තන්ට උපදෙස් දී තිබෙන්නේ සොහොන සොයා ගත්තත් වෙනත් තැනක කාලය ගත කරන්න කියලා.

flores_passage_en: UN peacekeepers, whom arrived in Haiti after the 2010 earthquake, are being blamed for the spread of the disease which started near the troop's encampment. According to the lawsuit, waste from the UN camp was not properly sanitized, causing bacteria to enter the tributary of the Artibonite River, one of Haiti's largest. Prior to the arrival of troops, Haiti had not encountered problems related to the disease since the 1800s. The Haitian Institute for Justice and Democracy has referenced independent studies that suggest the Nepalese UN peacekeeping battalion unknowingly brought the disease to Haiti. Danielle Lantagne, a UN expert on the disease, stated the outbreak was likely caused by the peacekeepers.
question_en: According to the passage, what would most likely have happened if the Nepalese UN peacekeeping battalion had not arrived in Haiti in 2010?
mc_answer1_en: The UN would have immediately relocated its peacekeeping camp to another country.
mc_answer2_en: Haitian authorities would have independently discovered the bacteria in the river before 2010.
mc_answer3_en: Haiti would have continued to have no outbreaks of the disease since the 1800s.
mc_answer4_en: The Artibonite River would have become completely free of all bacteria.

question: මෙම ඡේදයට අනුව, නේපාලයේ එක්සත් ජාතීන්ගේ සාම සාධක බලකාය 2010 දී හයිටියට නොපැමිණි නම් බොහෝ දුරට සිදුවිය හැක්කේ කුමක්ද?

flores_passage_en: The Iraq Study Group presented its report at 12.00 GMT today. It warns No one can guarantee that any course of action in Iraq at this point will stop sectarian warfare, growing violence, or a slide toward chaos. The Report opens with plea for open debate and the formation of a consensus in the United States about the policy towards the Middle East. The Report is highly critical of almost every aspect of the present policy of the Executive towards Iraq and it urges an immediate change of direction. First among its 78 recommendations is that a new diplomatic initiative should be taken before the end of this year to secure Iraq’s borders against hostile interventions and to re-establish diplomatic relations with its neighbors.
question_en: Based on the passage, if the Iraq Study Group's recommendation for a new diplomatic initiative had not been implemented by the end of the year, which of the following consequences would most likely have occurred according to the report's logic?
mc_answer1_en: Sectarian warfare would have been completely prevented regardless of other actions
mc_answer2_en: The United States would have immediately withdrawn all military forces from Iraq
mc_answer3_en: Iraq's borders might have remained vulnerable to hostile interventions from neighboring countries

flores_passage: ඉරාක අධ් යයන කණ්ඩායම අද GMT 12.00 ට සිය වාර්තාව ඉදිරිපත් කළේය. එය අනතුරු අඟවයි මේ අවස්ථාවේ ඉරාකයේ ඕනෑම ක් රියාමාර්ගයක් මඟින් නිකායික යුද්ධය, වර්ධනය වන ප් රචණ්ඩත්වය හෝ අවුල් ජාලය කරා ගමන් කිරීම නවත්වනු ඇතැයි කිසිවෙකුට සහතික විය නොහැක. වාර්තාව විවෘත විවාදයක් සඳහා ආයාචනයක් සහ මැදපෙරදිග ප් රතිපත්තිය පිළිබඳව එක්සත් ජනපදයේ එකඟතාවක් ඇති කර ගැනීමෙන් වාර්තාව විවෘත වේ. වාර්තාව ඉරාකය කෙරෙහි විධායකයේ වර්තමාන ප් රතිපත්තියේ සෑම අංශයක්ම පාහේ ඉතා විවේචනාත්මක වන අතර එය වහාම දිශාව වෙනස් කරන ලෙස ඉල්ලා සිටී. එහි නිර්දේශ 78 න් පළමුවැන්න නම්, සතුරු ආක් රමණයන්ගෙන් ඉරාකයේ දේශසීම ආරක්ෂා කිරීම සහ එහි අසල්වැසියන් සමඟ රාජ් ය තාන්ත් රික සබඳතා නැවත ඇති කර ගැනීම සඳහා මේ වසර අවසන් වීමට පෙර නව රාජ් ය තාන්ත් රික මුලපුරණයක් ගත යුතු බවයි.
question: මෙම ඡේදය මත පදනම්ව, ඉරාක අධ් යයන කණ්ඩායමේ නව රාජ් ය තාන්ත් රික මුලපිරීමක් සඳහා වූ නිර්දේශය වසර අවසානය වන විට ක් රියාත්මක කර නොමැති නම්, වාර්තාවේ තර්කනයට අනුව පහත සඳහන් ප් රතිවිපාකවලින් වඩාත්ම සිදුවිය හැක්කේ කුමක්ද?
mc_answer1: වෙනත් ක් රියාමාර්ග නොතකා ආගම්වාදී යුද්ධය සම්පූර්ණයෙන්ම වැළැක්විය හැකියි
mc_answer2: එක්සත් ජනපදය වහාම ඉරාකයෙන් සියළුම හමුදා ඉවත් කරාවි
mc_answer3: ඉරාකයේ දේශසීමා අසල්වැසි රටවල සතුරු මැදිහත්වීම් වලට ගොදුරු විය හැකියි
mc_answer4: මැදපෙරදිග ප් රතිපත්තිය සම්බන්ධයෙන් සම්මුතියක් ස්වයංක් රීයව විධායක ශාඛාව තුළ ඇති විය හැකියි

flores_passage_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo. The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE. Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.
question_en: Based on the passage, if the Spanish conquerors had not killed the Taínos between 1492 and 1498, which of the following would most likely have been true?
mc_answer1_en: The Taínos would have continued to inhabit Hispaniola with a significantly larger population.
mc_answer2_en: The population of Taínos would have remained stable throughout the early colonial period.
mc_answer3_en: The Taínos would have migrated to other parts of the Americas to avoid conflict.
mc_answer4_en: The Spanish would have been unable to establish settlements in the Dominican Republic.
flores_passage: ඩොමිනිකන් ජනරජය (Spanish: República Dominicana) යනු කැරිබියානු රටක් වන අතර එය හිස්පැනියෝලා දූපතේ නැගෙනහිර අර්ධය හිමි වන අතර එය හයිටි සමඟ බෙදා ගනී. සුදු වැලි සහිත වෙරළ සහ කඳුකර භූ දර්ශන හැරුණු විට, රට ඇමරිකාවේ පැරණිතම යුරෝපීය නගරය වන අතර එය දැන් සැන්ටෝ ඩොමින්ගෝ හි කොටසකි. මෙම දූපතේ මුලින්ම වාසය කළේ ටයිනෝස් සහ කැරිබියන් ය. කැරිබියන් යනු ක් රිස්තු පූර්ව 10,000 දී පමණ පැමිණි අරාවාක් භාෂාව කතා කරන ජනතාවකි. යුරෝපීය ගවේෂකයන්ගේ පැමිණීමෙන් පසු වසර කිහිපයක් ඇතුළත, ස්පා Spanish ් con ජයග් රාහකයින් විසින් ටයිනෝස් ජනගහනය සැලකිය යුතු ලෙස අඩු කරන ලදී.
question: 1492 සහ 1498 අතර කාලයේදී ස්පාඤ්ඤ යටත් විජිතකරුවන් ටයිනෝ වැසියන් මරා නොදැමුවේ නම්

mc_answer2: ටයිනෝස් හි ජනගහනය මුල් යටත් විජිත සමය පුරාම ස්ථාවරව පැවතුනි.
mc_answer3: ටයිනෝවරුන් ගැටුම් වළක්වා ගැනීම සඳහා ඇමරිකාවේ වෙනත් ප් රදේශවලට සංක් රමණය වී ඇත.
mc_answer4: ස්පාඤ්ඤය ඩොමිනිකන් ජනරජයේ ජනාවාස පිහිටුවීමට නොහැකි වනු ඇත.

flores_passage_en: "The photographer was transported to Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, where he subsequently died. He was reportedly aged in his 20s. Entertainment news website TMZ understands the photographer stopped his vehicle on the other side of Sepulveda Boulevard and attempted to take pictures of the police stop before crossing the road and continuing, prompting the California Highway Patrol police officer conducting the traffic stop to order him back across, twice. According to police, the driver of the vehicle that hit the photographer is unlikely to face criminal charges."
question_en: What would most likely have happened to the photographer if the California Highway Patrol officer had not ordered him back across the road twice?
mc_answer1_en: The photographer would have been struck by the vehicle that hit him regardless of the officer's orders.
mc_answer2_en: The photographer would have been charged with reckless driving.
mc_answer3_en: The photographer would have successfully taken pictures without incident.

flores_passage_en: In France, voting has traditionally been a low-tech experience: voters isolate themselves in a booth, put a pre-printed sheet of paper indicating their candidate of choice into an envelope. After officials verify the voter's identity, the voter drops the envelope into the ballot box and signs the voting roll. French electoral law rather strictly codifies the proceedings. Since 1988, ballot boxes must be transparent so that voters and observers can witness that no envelopes are present at the start of the vote and that no envelopes are added except those of the duly counted and authorized voters. Candidates can send representatives to witness every part of the process. In the evening, votes are counted by volunteers under heavy supervision, following specific procedures.
question_en: If the 1988 law requiring transparent ballot boxes had not been enacted, which of the following consequences would most likely have occurred based on the passage's description of the voting process?
mc_answer1_en: Candidates would have lost the right to send representatives to witness the voting process.
mc_answer2_en: Officials would have stopped verifying the identity of voters before they cast their ballots.
mc_answer3_en: Volunteers counting the votes would have been unable to sign the voting roll.
mc_answer4_en: Voters would have been unable to verify the integrity of the ballot box contents before voting.

question: විනිවිද පෙනෙන ඡන්ද පෙට්ටි අවශ් ය කරන 1988 නීතිය සම්මත කර නොතිබුනේ නම්, ඡන්ද ක් රියාවලිය පිළිබඳ ඡේදයේ විස්තරය මත පදනම්ව පහත සඳහන් ප් රතිවිපාකවලින් වඩාත්ම සිදුවිය හැක්කේ කුමක්ද?

flores_passage_en: "Blogs can also help improve student writing. While students often begin their blog experience with sloppy grammar and spelling, the presence of an audience generally changes that. Since students are often the most critical audience, the blog writer begins to strive to improve writing to avoid criticism. Also blogging ""forces students to become more savvy about the world around them."" The need to feed the interest of the audience inspires students to be clever and interesting (Toto, 2004). Blogging is a tool that inspires collaboration, and encourages students to extend learning well beyond the traditional school day. Appropriate use of blogs ""can empower students to become more analytical and critical; through actively responding to Internet materials, students can define their positions in the context of others' writings as well as outline their own perspectives on particular issues (Oravec, 2002)."
question_en: According to the passage, if students had not been exposed to blogging, which of the following outcomes would most likely have occurred?
mc_answer1_en: Students would have defined their positions more clearly through writing.
mc_answer2_en: Students would have developed stronger collaboration skills.

question: මෙම ඡේදයට අනුව, ශිෂ් යයන් බ්ලොග්කරණයට නිරාවරණය වී නොමැති නම්, පහත සඳහන් ප් රති results ලවලින් වඩාත්ම සිදුවිය හැක්කේ කුමක්ද?

mc_answer3: ශිෂ් යයන් ඔවුන්ගේම ලිවීම ගැන අඩු විවේචනාත්මකව සිටියා.

flores_passage_en: "One of the most common methods used to illustrate the importance of socialization is to draw upon the few unfortunate cases of children who were, through neglect, misfortune, or wilful abuse, not socialized by adults while they were growing up. Such children are called ""feral"" or wild. Some feral children have been confined by people (usually their own parents); in some cases this child abandonment was due to the parents' rejection of a child's severe intellectual or physical impairment. Feral children may have experienced severe child abuse or trauma before being abandoned or running away. Others are alleged to have been brought up by animals; some are said to have lived in the wild on their own. When completely brought up by non-human animals, the feral child exhibits behaviors (within physical limits) almost entirely like those of the particular care-animal, such as its fear of or indifference to humans."
question_en: According to the passage, what would most likely have been different for a feral child who was brought up by wolves, had the child never experienced severe abuse or trauma prior to being abandoned?
mc_answer1_en: The child's behavior would have been less influenced by the wolf's characteristics and more shaped by the abuse.
mc_answer2_en: The child would have rejected the wolf's care and sought human contact immediately upon recovery.
mc_answer3_en: The child would still have exhibited behaviors almost entirely like those of the wolf, as the passage suggests upbringing by animals overrides prior trauma in shaping behavior.
mc_answer4_en: The child would have developed human-like communication skills despite the lack of socialization.

mc_answer2: ළමයා වෘකයාගේ රැකවරණය ප් රතික්ෂේප කරලා මිනිස් සබඳතාවක් පවත්වාගෙන යන්න ඇති.

flores_passage_en: "Technological determinism is a term that encompasses a wide range of ideas in practice, from technology-push or the technological imperative to a strict sense that human destiny is driven by an underlying logic associated with scientific laws and their manifestation in technology. Most interpretations of technological determinism share two general ideas: that the development of technology itself follows a path largely beyond cultural or political influence, and that technology in turn has ""effects"" on societies that are inherent, rather than socially conditioned. For example, one might say that the motor car necessarily leads to the development of roads. However, a nationwide road network is not economically viable for just a handful of cars, so new methods of production are developed to reduce the cost of car ownership. Mass car ownership also leads to a higher incidence of accidents on the roads, which leads to the invention of new techniques in healthcare for repairing damaged bodies."
question_en: If the development of technology had not been driven by the logic of scientific laws, according to the passage, which of the following consequences would most likely follow regarding the relationship between technology and society?
mc_answer1_en: Technological development would become entirely dependent on cultural and political influences.
mc_answer2_en: Mass car ownership would not have led to the invention of new healthcare techniques.
mc_answer3_en: The motor car would have necessarily led to the immediate development of a nationwide road network.
mc_answer4_en: Technological determinism would cease to exist as a concept.
flores_passage: "තාක්ෂණික නිර්ණායකවාදය යනු තාක් ෂණික තල්ලුව හෝ තාක් ෂණික අවශ් යතාවයේ සිට මිනිස් ඉරණම විද් යාත්මක නීති හා ඒවායේ ප් රකාශනය හා සම්බන්ධ මූලික තර්කනයකින් මෙහෙයවනු ලැබේ යන දැඩි හැඟීම දක්වා ප් රායෝගිකව අදහස් රාශියක් ඇතුළත් වන යෙදුමකි. තාක් ෂණික නිර්නායකවාදය පිළිබඳ බොහෝ අර්ථ නිරූපණයන් පොදු අදහස් දෙකක් බෙදා ගනී: තාක් ෂණයේ දියුණුව බොහෝ දුරට සංස්කෘතික හෝ දේශපාලන බලපෑමෙන් ඔබ්බට ගිය මාවතක් අනුගමනය කරන අතර තාක් ෂණයට සමාජය මත පදනම් වූවාට වඩා සමාජයට ආවේණික වූ "ප් රතිවිපාක" ඇති බව. නිදසුනක් වශයෙන්, යමෙකුට මෝටර් රථය අනිවාර්යයෙන්ම මාර්ග සංවර්ධනයට තුඩු දෙන බව පැවසිය හැකිය. කෙසේ වෙතත්, මෝටර් රථ අතලොස්සක් සඳහා පමණක් රට පුරා මාර්ග ජාලයක් ආර්ථික වශයෙන් ශක් ය නොවේ, එබැවින් මෝටර් රථන හිමිකත්වීමේ පිරිවැය අඩු කිරීම සඳහා නව නිෂ්පාදන ක් රම නිර්මාණය කෙරේ. මහා වාහන අයිතිය ද මාර්ගවල සිදුවන අනතුරු ඉහළින් සිදුවීමට හේතු වන අතර, එමඟින් හානිසා හානිසා හාන ලදවීම් සඳහා නව සෞඛ් ය සේවාර ක් රම සොයා ගැනීමට හේතු වේ. "
question: තාක්ෂණයේ සංවර්ධනය විද් යාත්මක නීතිවල තර්කනය මගින් මෙහෙයවනු නොලැබේ නම්, මෙම ඡේදයට අනුව, තාක්ෂණය හා සමාජය අතර සම්බන්ධතාවය සම්බන්ධයෙන් පහත සඳහන් ප් රතිවිපාක වඩාත් අනුගමනය කරනු ඇත.
mc_answer1: තාක්ෂණික සංවර්ධනය සම්පූර්ණයෙන්ම සංස්කෘතික හා දේශපාලන බලපෑම් මත රඳා පවතී.
mc_answer2: මහා පරිමාණ වාහන අයිතිය නව සෞඛ් ය තාක්ෂණික ක් රමවේදයන් සොයාගැනීමට හේතු නොවනු ඇත.
mc_answer3: මෝටර් රථය අනිවාර්යයෙන්ම රට පුරා මාර්ග ජාලයක් වහාම සංවර්ධනය කිරීමට හේතු වනු ඇත.
mc_answer4: තාක්ෂණික නිර්ණායකවාදය සංකල්පයක් ලෙස පැවතීම නතර කරයි.
